translation: 城堡；【课件】(build) castles in the air 空中楼阁，幻想
original_sentence: It may sound like we are building castles in the air, but given the rate at which artificial intelligence, or AI, is being developed, such technology may not be far away.
definitionEn: a large strong building with thick walls, built in the past to defend against attack; (figuratively) in 'castles in the air', an impossible hope or plan.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （象棋中的）车（同 rook）
uncommonMeanings.example: In chess, the castle can only move in straight lines.

posExamples.example: The old castle on the hill attracts thousands of tourists every year.
posExamples.translation: 山上那座古老的城堡每年吸引成千上万的游客。

idioms.meaning: 建造空中楼阁；幻想，空想
idioms.example: Stop building castles in the air and get down to some practical work.

collocations.translation: 空想，幻想（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Many of his ideas, which were believed to be castles in the air, have turned into reality.
They spent the afternoon exploring a medieval castle.

synonyms.example: The fortress guarded the entrance to the harbour.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，指军事防御建筑，比 castle 更强调防御功能

synonyms.example: The king lived in a grand palace.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，指王室居住的华丽宫殿，不强调防御

advancedExpressions.expression: build castles in the air 空想；castles in the air 空中楼阁
advancedExpressions.example: His plan to become a millionaire overnight was just building castles in the air.

advancedExpressions.expression: given + n. = considering / in view of，作介词意为“考虑到，鉴于”；given that 引导从句
advancedExpressions.example: Given his age, he is a remarkably active man. Given that she is interested in children, teaching is the right career for her.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: It may sound impossible, but AI is developing fast.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It may sound like we are building castles in the air, but given the rate at which AI is being developed, such technology may not be far away.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用习语 build castles in the air 替换 impossible，并用 given 引出让步性背景，更地道

classPractice.question: 他的许多想法，曾被认为是空想，现在已经变成了现实。Many of his ideas, ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ (被认为是空想), have turned into reality.
classPractice.answer: which were believed to be castles in the air
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；build/be castles in the air 表示“空想”，此处用非限制性定语从句

classPractice.question: 不要再空想了，该着手做些实际的工作了。Don't ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ any more. Please ____ ____ ____ some practical work.
classPractice.answer: build castles in the air / get down to
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；get down to (doing) sth 意为“着手做某事”，to 为介词

classPractice.question: ____ (give) his poor health, it was a mistake for him to travel alone.
classPractice.note: given 作介词，意为“考虑到，鉴于”，置于句首

translation: 【课件】n. 输入，投入（时间、知识、意见等）；vt. 输入（信息、数据）（input-input-input）
original_sentence: AI systems learn from the input of huge amounts of data and gradually improve their performance.
definitionEn: time, knowledge, ideas, money or effort that you put into work or an activity to make it succeed; (verb) to put information into a computer.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （电路的）输入端；输入功率
uncommonMeanings.example: Connect the cable to the audio input on the back of the device.

posExamples.example: We listen to our employees and value their input.
posExamples.translation: 我们倾听员工的意见，并重视他们的贡献。

posExamples.example: You need to input all the data before running the program.
posExamples.translation: 运行程序前你需要把所有数据都输入进去。

wordForms.meaning: 输入，投入（过去式、过去分词均为 input）

collocations.example: The input of resources into the project has been enormous.

collocations.phrase: have an input in / into sth
collocations.translation: 对某事物有所贡献（课件搭配）
collocations.example: Teaching allows teachers to have an input in the development of students.
Data input by hand is slow and error-prone.
The manager always values his team's input.

synonyms.example: Everyone made a valuable contribution to the discussion.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，make a contribution to sth，强调所贡献的具体成果

synonyms.example: Please enter your password to log in.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，enter data/information into，与 input 作动词时同义

advancedExpressions.expression: input 输入、投入 ↔ output 输出、产出；两词皆可作名词与动词
advancedExpressions.example: Manufacturing output has increased, but the input of raw materials also rose.

advancedExpressions.expression: input / contribution / involvement / participation，均可表“投入、参与”供替换升级
advancedExpressions.example: Their input into the community project greatly improved local facilities.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The AI learns from a lot of data.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The AI system learns from the input of huge amounts of data.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 the input of 名词化结构替换动词 learn from data，书面语更正式

classPractice.question: 教学是一个有益的过程，它让教师对学生的发展有所贡献。Teaching is a rewarding process, which allows teachers to ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.answer: have an input in the development of students
classPractice.note: 课件例句；have an input in sth 意为“对某事有所贡献”

classPractice.question: 用 input / output 填空：Manual workers need a good breakfast for high-energy ____.
classPractice.note: output 指“产出、输出”，此处指体力工作者的能量产出

classPractice.question: The teacher valued every student's ____ (input) during the group discussion.
classPractice.note: input 作名词“投入、意见”，此处不可数，作 valued 的宾语

translation: 【课件】n. 1) 容量，容纳能力；2) （做某事的）能力；3) 职责，职位，身份
original_sentence: These systems have the capacity to analyse massive amounts of data through multiple layers, imitating the complex networks of the human brain.
definitionEn: the ability to do something; the amount that something can contain or produce; a particular position or role.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 职责，职位，身份（role）
uncommonMeanings.example: She organized the meeting in her capacity as manager.

posExamples.example: Humans are all born with the capacity to be creative.
posExamples.translation: 人类天生就有创造的能力。

posExamples.example: The hall has a seating capacity of 2,000.
posExamples.translation: 这个大厅可容纳 2,000 个座位。

wordForms.meaning: 容量；能力；职位（复数 capacities）
有能力的，能胜任的（be capable of doing sth）

collocations.phrase: have the capacity to do sth
collocations.translation: 有能力做某事（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: AI systems have the capacity to analyse massive amounts of data.

collocations.translation: 全力地，满负荷地（课件搭配）
collocations.example: Bread factories are working at full capacity.
The stadium has a seating capacity of 60,000.

collocations.translation: 做某事的能力（课件搭配）
collocations.example: Limited resources are restricting our capacity for developing new products.
In her capacity as head teacher, she welcomed the new students.

synonyms.example: He has the ability to work under pressure.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，the ability to do sth；capacity 更强调潜在的、可发展的能力

synonyms.example: The tank has a volume of 500 litres.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，指所占空间的大小；capacity 强调最大容纳量

advancedExpressions.expression: 1) 容量 at full capacity 2) 能力 the capacity to do / for sth 3) 身份 in one's capacity as
advancedExpressions.example: In his capacity as director, he pushed the factory to run at full capacity, showing his capacity for leadership.

advancedExpressions.expression: capacity（潜在的、可容纳或可发展的能力）/ ability（已具备的实际能力）/ capability（性能、才干）
advancedExpressions.example: She has the ability to teach and the capacity to grow into a leader.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: These systems can analyse a lot of data.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: These systems have the capacity to analyse massive amounts of data.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 have the capacity to do 替换 can，书面语更正式，突出“具备……能力”

classPractice.question: 她以经理的身份组织了这次会议。She organized the meeting ____ ____ ____ ____ manager.
classPractice.note: 课件例句；in one's capacity as 意为“以……的身份”

classPractice.question: 用适当介词/搭配填空：Limited resources are restricting our capacity ____ developing new products.
classPractice.note: 课件搭配 capacity for (doing) sth 意为“做某事的能力”

classPractice.question: 人类天生就有创造的能力。Humans are all born with ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: capacity to do sth“做某事的能力”，与 born with 搭配

translation: 巨大的，大量的；大规模的；（尤指程度、影响）非常严重的
original_sentence: These systems have the capacity to analyse massive amounts of data through multiple layers, imitating the complex networks of the human brain.
definitionEn: extremely large in size, amount, or degree.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （疾病、发作等）严重的，大面积的
uncommonMeanings.example: He suffered a massive heart attack and was rushed to hospital.

posExamples.example: AI can process massive amounts of data in seconds.
posExamples.translation: 人工智能能在几秒内处理海量数据。

collocations.translation: 海量数据（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: These systems analyse massive amounts of data through multiple layers.
There has been a massive increase in online shopping.
The technology is now being used on a massive scale.

synonyms.example: The project required an enormous amount of money.
synonyms.usage: 作形容词，作定语或表语；与 massive 高度同义，常可互换

synonyms.example: A huge quantity of data was collected.
synonyms.usage: 作形容词，口语和书面均常用；massive 更强调分量重、程度深

advancedExpressions.expression: massive / enormous / huge / vast / immense，均表“巨大的、大量的”供替换升级
advancedExpressions.example: The AI processes vast quantities of information at immense speed.

advancedExpressions.expression: mass（团、块；大量；质量）→ massive（巨大的）→ massively（大量地）
advancedExpressions.example: The mass of the star determines its gravity; a massive star has massive gravity.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: These systems analyse a lot of data.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: These systems have the capacity to analyse massive amounts of data.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 massive amounts of 替换 a lot of，更书面、更能突出数据量之大

classPractice.question: 用 massive / massively / mass 填空：AI can process ____ amounts of data in seconds.
classPractice.note: 此处修饰名词 amounts，需用形容词 massive

classPractice.question: There was a huge increase in the number of users. → There was a ____ increase in the number of users.
classPractice.note: massive 与 huge 同义，均表“巨大的”

classPractice.question: The new technology is being adopted ____ (massive) across the country.
classPractice.note: 此处修饰动词 is being adopted，需用副词 massively

translation: 网络，网状系统；（人或组织的）网络，网状组织；vt. 将……连接成网络；建立人际网络
original_sentence: These systems have the capacity to analyse massive amounts of data through multiple layers, imitating the complex networks of the human brain.
definitionEn: a large system of connected parts, people, computers, roads, etc. that work together.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 建立人际关系网，广结人脉
uncommonMeanings.example: Conferences are a good place to network with people in your field.

posExamples.example: The human brain contains complex networks of nerve cells.
posExamples.translation: 人脑中含有由神经细胞构成的复杂网络。

posExamples.example: A network of roads connects the cities across the country.
posExamples.translation: 四通八达的公路网将全国各城市连接起来。

collocations.phrase: the complex networks of the human brain
collocations.translation: 人脑的复杂网络（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Neural networks imitate the complex networks of the human brain.
Deep learning relies on artificial neural networks.
Many teenagers spend hours on social networks every day.
The company has built a network of suppliers across Asia.

synonyms.example: A web of railways covers the whole region.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，a web of sth，比喻错综复杂的联系；network 更强调互联互通的系统

synonyms.example: The transport system in the city is highly efficient.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，强调有组织的整体；network 强调节点间的连接

advancedExpressions.expression: a neural network 神经网络；a social network 社交网络；a network of roads/suppliers ……网
advancedExpressions.example: Artificial neural networks power modern AI.

advancedExpressions.expression: network (n./v.) → networking (n. 建立人脉)
advancedExpressions.example: Networking is an important skill for job hunters.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: AI copies how the human brain works.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: AI imitates the complex networks of the human brain.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 imitate the complex networks of the human brain 具体化“模仿大脑”，更学术

classPractice.question: Deep learning systems imitate the complex ____ (network) of the human brain.
classPractice.note: network 作可数名词，此处需用复数 networks

classPractice.question: 用 network / system 填空：The subway ____ connects every corner of the city.
classPractice.note: network 强调线路节点互联成网，符合地铁线路语境

classPractice.question: 会议是与同行建立人脉的好地方。Conferences are a good place to ____ with people in your field.
classPractice.note: network 作不及物动词，意为“建立人际网络，广结人脉”

translation: 【课件】vt. 创造（新词或短语）；n. 硬币
original_sentence: Jaron Lanier coined the term 'virtual reality' and pioneered its early development.
definitionEn: to invent a new word or phrase that other people begin to use; (noun) a small round piece of metal used as money.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 铸造（硬币）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the past, only the government had the right to coin money.

posExamples.example: He coined the term 'artificial intelligence' back in 1956.
posExamples.translation: 早在 1956 年他就创造了“人工智能”这个术语。

posExamples.example: She dropped a few coins into the beggar's cup.
posExamples.translation: 她往乞丐的杯子里投了几枚硬币。

idioms.meaning: 套用一句老话；用老话来说
idioms.example: No news is good news, to coin a phrase.

collocations.translation: 创造这个术语/词（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Jaron Lanier coined the term 'virtual reality'.

collocations.phrase: the other side of the coin
collocations.example: Low pay is the other side of the coin of falling unemployment.

collocations.phrase: two sides of the same coin
collocations.translation: 同一事物密切相关的两个方面（课件搭配）
collocations.example: Theory and practice are two sides of the same coin.

synonyms.example: He invented a machine that could translate languages.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，指发明实物或方法；coin 专指创造词语或说法

synonyms.example: The writer created a whole new world in her novel.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，泛指“创造”；coin 更具体，专用于词语

advancedExpressions.expression: coin the term 创造术语；the other side of the coin 另一方面；two sides of the same coin 一体两面；to coin a phrase 套用老话
advancedExpressions.example: The benefits and risks of AI are two sides of the same coin.

advancedExpressions.expression: coin vt. 创造 + pioneer n./v. 先驱、开拓（a pioneer in/of sth; pioneer sth）
advancedExpressions.example: He coined the term and pioneered its early development.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Jaron Lanier made up the words 'virtual reality'.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Jaron Lanier coined the term 'virtual reality' and pioneered its early development.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 coin the term 替换口语化的 make up the words，并用 pioneer 提升表达

classPractice.question: These findings are a reminder that low pay is ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ falling unemployment. （另一方面）
classPractice.answer: the other side of the coin of
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；the other side of the coin (of) 意为“……的另一方面”

classPractice.question: Theory and practice are ____ ____ ____ ____ ____, which depend on each other. （密切相关）
classPractice.answer: two sides of the same coin
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；two sides of the same coin 表“一体两面、密切相关”

classPractice.question: 杰伦·拉尼尔创造了“虚拟现实”这个词，并成为推动其早期发展的先驱人物。Jaron Lanier ____ ____ ____ 'virtual reality' and pioneered its early development.
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；coin the term 意为“创造这个术语”

translation: （尤指科技上的）重大突破，重要进展
original_sentence: Recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence have made machines capable of learning and solving problems on their own.
definitionEn: an important new discovery or development, especially in science, that helps to solve a problem.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （谈判、僵局中的）突破性进展
uncommonMeanings.example: The two sides finally made a breakthrough in the peace talks.

posExamples.example: Scientists have made a major breakthrough in cancer treatment.
posExamples.translation: 科学家在癌症治疗方面取得了重大突破。

wordForms.meaning: 重大突破（合成词 break + through）

collocations.example: Scientists think they are beginning to make a breakthrough in the fight against cancer.
The discovery was hailed as a major breakthrough in medicine.
There has been a breakthrough in artificial intelligence research.

synonyms.example: Recent advances in technology have changed our lives.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，an advance in sth；breakthrough 更强调“突破性”“关键性”

synonyms.example: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，指新发现；breakthrough 强调解决难题的关键进展

advancedExpressions.expression: breakthrough (n. 重大突破) 由动词短语 break through（突破，突围）合成；类比 break-in（闯入）、breakout（爆发）
advancedExpressions.example: After years of research, they finally broke through — that breakthrough changed the field.

advancedExpressions.expression: break through 突破；break down 损坏、分解；break out 爆发；break up 分裂；break into 闯入；break off 中断；break away from 脱离
advancedExpressions.example: Negotiations broke down before the two sides could break through.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Scientists have made great progress in AI.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence have transformed the way machines learn.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用名词 breakthroughs 替换泛泛的 progress，突出“突破性”

classPractice.question: 科学家认为他们在对抗癌症的研究中开始有所突破。Scientists think they are beginning to ____ ____ ____ in the fight against cancer.
classPractice.note: 由课件动词短语 break through 关联；名词搭配 make a breakthrough 意为“取得突破”

classPractice.question: 用 breakthrough (n.) 或 break through (v.) 填空：After months of effort, the team managed to ____ in the negotiations.
classPractice.note: 此处需动词短语 break through“突破”；作名词时应写作 breakthrough

classPractice.question: There has been a major ____ (break) in AI research this year.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词，合成词 breakthrough“重大突破”，前有 a major 修饰

translation: 【课件】n. 财政，金融；资金，财力（pl. finances 财务状况）；vt. 为……提供资金（fund）
original_sentence: Nowadays, AI is already being applied in many fields: finance, health care, machine translation and art, to name but a few.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 为……提供资金，资助（fund）

posExamples.example: AI is already being applied in fields such as finance and health care.
posExamples.translation: 人工智能已被应用于金融、医疗等领域。

wordForms.meaning: 财政，金融；资金；提供资金

collocations.translation: 在金融领域（课件原句词块）

collocations.translation: 陷入财务困境（课件搭配）

collocations.phrase: put a strain on one's finances

posExamples.translation: 他们自豪地宣布自己是一个新自治省的一部分。

collocations.translation: 自主运行的机器（课件话题词块）

collocations.translation: 自治省/自治区（课件搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: autonomous adj. 自主的 → autonomy n. 自主、自治权 → autonomously adv. 自主地
advancedExpressions.example: The robot works autonomously, showing a high degree of autonomy.

advancedExpressions.expression: 前缀 auto-（自己、自动）：autonomous 自主的、automatic 自动的、autobiography 自传
advancedExpressions.example: An autonomous car is a kind of automatic vehicle.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: In the future, machines may act by themselves without people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In the future, autonomous machines may make decisions and act independently without human control.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 autonomous 替换 act by themselves，一词到位，更学术

classPractice.question: These vehicles are fully ____ (autonomy) and need no human driver.
classPractice.note: 此处需形容词修饰主语，autonomy 的形容词为 autonomous

classPractice.question: The robot can complete the whole task ____ (autonomous), without any help.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 complete 需用副词 autonomously

classPractice.question: 该地区被赋予了高度的自治权。The region has been given a high degree of ____ (自治权).
classPractice.note: 此处需名词，autonomous 的名词形式为 autonomy

translation: 【课件】adj. 1) 国内的（national）；2) 家用的，家庭的（household）；3) （动物）驯养的
original_sentence: AI-powered domestic robots can now do household chores such as cleaning and cooking.
definitionEn: relating to a country's own affairs rather than foreign ones; connected with the home or family; (of animals) kept as pets or on farms.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （动物）驯养的，非野生的
uncommonMeanings.example: The cat is a domestic animal, unlike the wild lion.

posExamples.example: The airline has increased the number of domestic flights.
posExamples.translation: 该航空公司增加了国内航班的数量。

posExamples.example: Many domestic appliances are now controlled by AI.
posExamples.translation: 许多家用电器现在由人工智能控制。

collocations.translation: 家用机器人/家用电器（课件话题词块）
collocations.example: Domestic appliances make housework much easier.

collocations.translation: 国内事务/国内市场（课件搭配·国内的）
collocations.example: The government focused on domestic affairs this year.

collocations.translation: 国内航班（课件搭配·国内的）
collocations.example: All domestic flights were delayed by the storm.

collocations.translation: 家务/家政服务（课件搭配·家用的）
collocations.example: She shares the domestic chores with her husband.
The charity helps victims of domestic violence.

synonyms.example: Household appliances save a lot of time.
synonyms.usage: 作形容词，作定语；与 domestic 的“家用的”义同义

synonyms.example: The country's internal problems must be solved first.
synonyms.usage: 作形容词，指内部事务；与 domestic 的“国内的”义相近

advancedExpressions.expression: 1) 国内的 domestic affairs/flights/market 2) 家用的 domestic appliances/chores/violence 3) 驯养的 domestic animals
advancedExpressions.example: The domestic market for domestic appliances is growing fast.

advancedExpressions.expression: domestic adj. → domestically adv.（domestically produced goods 本国产品）
advancedExpressions.example: The company sells both domestically and overseas.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Robots that work at home can do housework now.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: AI-powered domestic robots can now do household chores such as cleaning and cooking.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 domestic 修饰 robots，用 household chores 替换 housework，更正式

classPractice.question: 用 domestic 的正确形式填空：Most of these products are ____ (domestic) produced and sold at home.
classPractice.note: 修饰过去分词 produced 需用副词 domestically

classPractice.question: 用 domestic / foreign 填空：The airline runs both ____ and international flights.
classPractice.note: 与 international 相对，domestic 指“国内的”

classPractice.question: 这些家用电器现在都由人工智能控制。These ____ appliances are now controlled by AI.
classPractice.note: domestic appliances 意为“家用电器”，此处取“家用的”义

translation: 【课件】vt. 威胁，恐吓；对……构成威胁（endanger）；vi.（危险等）可能发生，逼近
original_sentence: Some experts worry that advanced AI could one day threaten the existence of humans.
definitionEn: to be likely to harm or endanger someone or something; to say you will cause harm if someone does not do what you want.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （坏天气、危险等）逼近，可能来临
uncommonMeanings.example: Dark clouds gathered and a storm was threatening.

posExamples.example: Some experts warn that AI may threaten the existence of humans.
posExamples.translation: 一些专家警告说，人工智能可能会威胁到人类的生存。

collocations.translation: 威胁人类的生存（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Advanced AI could threaten the existence of humans.
The robber threatened him with a knife.

collocations.translation: 威胁要做某事（课件搭配）
collocations.example: His father threatened to throw him out.

collocations.translation: 受到……的威胁，面临危险（课件搭配）
collocations.example: These ancient woodlands are under threat from new road developments.
Drugs pose a major threat to our society.

synonyms.example: Pollution endangers many rare species.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，直接跟宾语；与 threaten 的“对……构成威胁”义同义

synonyms.example: The gang menaced local shopkeepers.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，语气较强，多用于书面；threaten 更常用

advancedExpressions.expression: threaten vt./vi. → threat n. 威胁（make threats against sb; under threat from; pose a threat to）→ threatening adj. 威胁的（life-threatening 危及生命的）
advancedExpressions.example: The threatening storm posed a serious threat to the coastal town.

advancedExpressions.expression: threaten sth / endanger sth / put sth at risk / pose a threat to sth，均表“对……构成威胁”供替换升级
advancedExpressions.example: Climate change puts many species at risk and poses a threat to food security.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Some experts think AI might be dangerous to people one day.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Some experts worry that advanced AI could one day threaten the existence of humans.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 threaten the existence of 替换 be dangerous to，动词化更凝练有力

classPractice.question: In both Africa and Asia elephants ____ (threaten) by changes in their natural habitats at present.
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；at present + elephants 与 threaten 为被动，用现在进行时被动 are being threatened

classPractice.question: Because of the drought, the people in this area are threatened ____ the poor harvest.
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；be threatened with/by 意为“受到……威胁”

classPractice.question: There are several things you can do to defend your home against this ____ (threaten).
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；this 后需名词，threaten 的名词为 threat

classPractice.question: His father threatened ____ (throw) him out, but he knew it was an empty ____ (threaten).
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；threaten to do sth“威胁要做某事”；an empty 后接名词 threat

translation: 【课件】vt. 1) 犯（罪、错等）（commit a crime/murder）；2) 承诺，保证；使（自己）投入、致力于（commit oneself to）
original_sentence: How would they be punished if they committed crimes or even murdered humans?
definitionEn: to do something wrong or illegal; to promise to do something or to give your time and effort to something.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 拨出，调拨（资金、资源等）
uncommonMeanings.example: They will have to commit more money to the project if they want it to succeed.

posExamples.example: The man denied that he had committed any crime.
posExamples.translation: 那个男人否认自己犯过任何罪。

posExamples.example: She committed herself to the scientific research.
posExamples.translation: 她全心全意投身于科学研究。

wordForms.meaning: 犯（罪）；承诺；使投入（双写 t：committed, committing）
忠诚的，坚定的，尽心尽力的

collocations.translation: 犯罪／犯谋杀罪（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: How would they be punished if they committed crimes or even murdered humans?

collocations.translation: 承诺做某事；致力于（课件搭配）
collocations.example: She committed herself to seeing a doctor at once.

collocations.translation: 向……投入更多的钱（课件搭配）
collocations.example: They'll have to commit more money to the project if they want it to succeed.
They have made a commitment to keep working together to cope with the issue.

synonyms.example: She devoted herself to helping the poor.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，devote oneself to (doing) sth；与 commit oneself to 同义，to 均为介词

synonyms.example: The crime was perpetrated by a gang of thieves.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，正式用语，指“犯罪”；口语中 commit 更常用

advancedExpressions.expression: commit vt. → commitment n. 承诺、投入（make a commitment to; a sense of commitment to）→ committed adj. 尽心尽力的
advancedExpressions.example: A career as an actor requires one hundred per cent commitment; she is fully committed to it.

advancedExpressions.type: 常用结构盒子·commit oneself to
advancedExpressions.expression: commit oneself to (doing) sth = devote oneself to = dedicate oneself to（to 为介词，后接名词或动名词）
advancedExpressions.example: He committed himself to protecting the environment.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: If robots do bad things or kill people, how do we punish them?
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: How would they be punished if they committed crimes or even murdered humans?
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 commit crimes / murder 替换 do bad things / kill，正式且符合与现在事实相反的虚拟语气

classPractice.question: When taken to the police station for questioning, the man said, "I have never ____ ____ ____ (犯任何罪)."
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；commit a crime“犯罪”，现在完成时用 committed

classPractice.question: She has ____ ____ ____ ____ (答应去看) a doctor at once.
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；commit oneself to doing sth，to 为介词接动名词

classPractice.question: They have ____ ____ ____ (作出承诺) to keep working together to cope with the issue.
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；make a commitment to do sth“承诺做某事”

classPractice.question: She ____ ____ ____ the scientific research. (全心全意献身于)
classPractice.note: 课件【语境应用】原题；commit oneself to sth“投身于、致力于”

translation: 罪，罪行；犯罪活动
original_sentence: How would they be punished if they committed crimes or even murdered humans?
definitionEn: an illegal act or activity that can be punished by law.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （泛指）犯罪活动，犯罪现象（不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: The government is trying hard to reduce crime in big cities.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）憾事，令人痛心的事
uncommonMeanings.example: It would be a crime to waste such a good opportunity.

posExamples.example: How would AI robots be punished if they committed crimes or even murdered humans?
posExamples.translation: 如果 AI 机器人犯了罪甚至谋杀了人类，又该如何惩罚它们呢？

posExamples.example: Advanced facial recognition helps the police fight crime more effectively.
posExamples.translation: 先进的人脸识别技术帮助警方更有效地打击犯罪。

collocations.example: The man insisted that he had never committed any crime.
New technology helps the police fight crime.
Murder is one of the most serious crimes.
The crime rate in the area has fallen sharply.

synonyms.example: Driving without a licence is a criminal offence.
synonyms.usage: offence 可指轻微违法或违规（commit an offence）；crime 语义更重，常指刑事犯罪。

synonyms.example: The company denied any wrongdoing.
synonyms.usage: wrongdoing 多为道德/法律上的过错，不可数，语气较正式。

advancedExpressions.expression: commit a crime / commit murder / commit a mistake
advancedExpressions.example: He was found guilty of the crime he had committed.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句
advancedExpressions.expression: If + 主语 + had done, 主语 + would/could/might have done
advancedExpressions.example: If the robot had committed a crime, how would it have been punished?

sentenceUpgrade.simple: AI robots may break the law. People worry about how to punish them.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is growing concern about how AI robots would be punished if they committed crimes.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 concern about + how 从句 + 虚拟条件句整合两句，更书面。

classPractice.question: The young man swore that he had never ______ (犯) any crime in his life.
classPractice.note: commit a crime 犯罪，此处用过去分词构成现在完成时。

classPractice.question: 先进技术帮助警方更有效地打击犯罪。
classPractice.answer: Advanced technology helps the police fight crime more effectively.
classPractice.note: fight crime 打击犯罪，crime 此处不可数。

classPractice.question: Murder is regarded as one of the most serious ______ (crime).
classPractice.note: 指具体的一桩桩罪行时可数，用复数。

translation: vt. 谋杀，凶杀；n. 谋杀（罪），凶杀（案）
original_sentence: How would they be punished if they committed crimes or even murdered humans?
definitionEn: to kill someone deliberately and illegally; the crime of killing someone deliberately.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）极难受/极难办的事
uncommonMeanings.example: Driving through the city at rush hour is murder.

posExamples.example: The article asks how a robot would be punished if it murdered a human.
posExamples.translation: 文章追问：如果机器人谋杀了人类，该如何惩罚它。

posExamples.example: He was found guilty of murder and sent to prison.
posExamples.translation: 他被判谋杀罪成立，被送进监狱。

collocations.example: The man denied that he had committed the murder.
He was found guilty of murder after a long trial.
In the novel, the butler murders his master for money.
The police finally solved the murder case.

synonyms.example: The disease killed thousands of people.
synonyms.usage: kill 泛指使死亡（可指人、动植物、也可指意外/疾病）；murder 特指非法蓄意杀人。

synonyms.example: The president was assassinated in public.
synonyms.usage: assassinate 专指出于政治等目的暗杀重要人物。

advancedExpressions.expression: commit (a) murder / commit a crime / commit suicide
advancedExpressions.example: Anyone who commits murder will face severe punishment.

advancedExpressions.expression: murder + -er → murderer 杀人犯
advancedExpressions.example: The murderer was finally caught by the police.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He killed a man on purpose, so he was punished.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Having been found guilty of murder, he was sentenced to life in prison.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用过去分词短语作状语 + be found guilty of，语言更凝练地道。

classPractice.question: The man was found ______ (guilt) of murder and put in prison.
classPractice.note: be found guilty of murder 被判谋杀罪成立，guilty 为形容词。

classPractice.question: The president was ______ (murdered / assassinated) by a political enemy.
classPractice.note: 针对政治要人的谋杀用 assassinate。

classPractice.question: The ______ (murder) was sentenced to life imprisonment.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词“凶手”，加 -er 表施动者。

translation: vt. 敦促，力劝，催促；强烈要求，竭力主张；驱赶【课件】；n. 强烈的欲望，冲动
original_sentence: These stories urge us to think about the dangers posed by the advances in AI.
definitionEn: to strongly advise or try hard to persuade someone to do something; a strong desire to do something.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 强烈的欲望，冲动【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: I had a sudden urge to hit him.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 驱赶，催赶（马、牲畜等前进）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: The farmer urged his horse forward.

posExamples.example: These stories urge us to think about the dangers posed by AI.
posExamples.translation: 这些故事敦促我们思考 AI 带来的危险。

posExamples.example: The report urged that all children (should) be taught to swim.
posExamples.translation: 这份报告呼吁教所有的儿童游泳。

posExamples.example: She managed to resist the urge to laugh.
posExamples.translation: 她强忍住笑出来的冲动。

collocations.translation: 力劝/敦促某人做某事【课件】
collocations.example: We did have to urge the students to relax before their examination.

collocations.translation: 竭力主张……（虚拟语气）【课件】
collocations.example: The expert urged that an open debate be held on this issue.

collocations.translation: 鼓励/激励某人（继续）【课件】
collocations.example: Her supportive sister urged her on.
He could hardly resist the urge to shout out.

collocations.phrase: have an urge to do sth
collocations.example: I had a sudden urge to call my old friend.

synonyms.example: She persuaded him to see a doctor.
synonyms.usage: persuade 强调“说服成功”（persuade sb to do 结果对方做了）；urge 只强调“极力劝，催促”，不含结果成功。

synonyms.example: The teacher encouraged us to speak more English.
synonyms.usage: encourage sb to do；语气比 urge 缓和，urge 更强烈、常带紧迫感。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·urge/demand 后从句的虚拟语气
advancedExpressions.expression: urge/demand/suggest/insist + that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形
advancedExpressions.example: The report urged that all children (should) be taught to swim.

advancedExpressions.expression: urge sb to do / call on sb to do / appeal to sb to do
advancedExpressions.example: The UN urged/called on all countries to take action.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: These stories tell us we should think about the dangers of AI.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: These stories urge us to reflect on the dangers posed by the rapid advances in AI.
sentenceUpgrade.note: urge sb to do 替换 tell...should，posed by 后置定语更凝练。

classPractice.question: She was surprised at the ______ (urge) in his voice and didn't know what to do.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：the + ___ + in his voice，需名词“急迫”，用 urgency。

classPractice.question: We did have to ______ ______ ______ ______ (urge the students to relax) before their examination.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：urge sb to do sth 力劝某人做某事。

classPractice.question: It ______ (urge) that the spirit of Lei Feng should be greatly advocated in today's society.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：It is urged that ... (should) do 固定虚拟句型。

classPractice.question: They've made an ______ (urge) request for good methods of learning English.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：request 前需形容词，用 urgent。

translation: vt. 造成，引起（威胁、问题等）【课件】；提出（问题）；vi. 摆姿势（拍照）；n. 姿势
original_sentence: These stories urge us to think about the dangers posed by the advances in AI.
definitionEn: to create a threat or problem that has to be dealt with; to ask a question; to hold a particular position for a photograph.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 提出（问题）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher posed a difficult question to the class.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 摆好姿势（准备拍照）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: The winners posed for a photograph.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 姿势，姿态【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: We took photos in various poses.

posExamples.example: Advances in AI may pose a serious threat to human beings.
posExamples.translation: 人工智能的进步可能对人类构成严重威胁。

posExamples.example: The reporter posed a sharp question at the press conference.
posExamples.translation: 那名记者在新闻发布会上提出了一个尖锐的问题。

posExamples.example: The team posed for photos after winning the match.
posExamples.translation: 球队在赢得比赛后摆姿势拍照。

collocations.translation: 对……构成威胁/危险/风险【课件】
collocations.example: Drugs pose a major threat to our society.

collocations.translation: 造成问题/带来挑战【课件】
collocations.example: The heavy rain posed a serious problem for the farmers.
The scientist posed an important question for future research.
The family posed for a photograph in front of the castle.

collocations.translation: 由……造成的危险【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: We must think about the dangers posed by the advances in AI.

synonyms.example: The situation presents a real challenge to the government.
synonyms.usage: present a threat/problem 与 pose a threat/problem 基本同义可互换；pose 更强调“主动造成”。

synonyms.example: The storm caused serious damage to the crops.
synonyms.usage: cause 后接结果名词（damage/trouble）；pose 常固定接 threat/risk/problem/question。

advancedExpressions.expression: pose a threat/challenge/danger/risk to sb/sth；pose a question
advancedExpressions.example: AI could pose a threat to jobs and pose new questions about ethics.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·过去分词作后置定语
advancedExpressions.expression: the dangers posed by the advances in AI = the dangers that are posed by...
advancedExpressions.example: The dangers posed by AI (= that are posed by AI) demand our attention.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: AI brings some dangers. We should think about them.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We should think carefully about the dangers posed by the rapid advances in AI.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 posed by 过去分词后置定语替换 that AI brings，句子更紧凑。

classPractice.question: The advances in AI may ______ a serious threat to the existence of humans.
classPractice.note: pose a threat to 对……构成威胁，固定搭配。

classPractice.question: 改写：The dangers that are posed by AI demand our attention. → The dangers ______ ______ AI demand our attention.
classPractice.note: 定语从句 that are posed by 可简化为过去分词短语 posed by。

classPractice.question: 赢得比赛后，队员们摆姿势拍了合影。
classPractice.answer: After winning the match, the players posed for a photo.
classPractice.note: pose for a photo 摆姿势拍照。

translation: adv. 显然，显而易见；据说，据（表面）看来
original_sentence: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
definitionEn: used to say that something seems to be true, although you are not certain; clearly or obviously.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 据说，看样子（表转述、非亲眼所见）
uncommonMeanings.example: Apparently, he has already left for London.

posExamples.example: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
posExamples.translation: 显然，这样的警告需要得到我们的重视。

posExamples.example: Apparently the new software is much faster than the old one.
posExamples.translation: 据说这个新软件比旧的快得多。

collocations.translation: 显然……（常作句首插入语）【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
I thought he would come, but apparently not.
The machine stopped for no apparent reason.

synonyms.example: He was obviously tired after the long trip.
synonyms.usage: obviously 表“明摆着、毫无疑问”；apparently 除“显然”外还可表“据说、看似（未必真）”，语气更缓。

synonyms.example: The two seemingly different problems are in fact related.
synonyms.usage: seemingly 多作定语/状语，强调“表面上（实则可能不然）”，与 apparently 转述义相近。

advancedExpressions.expression: apparently / obviously / clearly / evidently / undoubtedly
advancedExpressions.example: Clearly/Apparently, these warnings deserve our attention.

advancedExpressions.expression: apparent (adj.) → apparently (adv.)；for no apparent reason
advancedExpressions.example: It became apparent that the plan would fail.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: It is clear that we should pay attention to such warnings.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用句首插入语 Apparently 替换 It is clear that，行文更简洁地道。

classPractice.question: ______ (apparent), such warnings demand our attention.
classPractice.note: 句首状语需副词，修饰整句，用 Apparently。

classPractice.question: I expected a reply, but ______ (apparently / apparent) not.
classPractice.note: apparently not 看来不（是），此处需副词。

classPractice.question: 据说那家公司下个月就要搬到新址了。
classPractice.answer: Apparently, the company is moving to a new location next month.
classPractice.note: Apparently 此处表“据说、看样子”。

translation: n. 警告，告诫；预兆，前兆
original_sentence: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
definitionEn: something that tells you that something bad may happen, so that you can avoid it or be ready for it.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 预兆，前兆（事情将发生的迹象）
uncommonMeanings.example: The dark clouds were a warning of the coming storm.

posExamples.example: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
posExamples.translation: 显然，这样的警告需要得到我们的重视。

posExamples.example: The scientist gave a warning about the risks of AI.
posExamples.translation: 这位科学家就 AI 的风险发出了警告。

collocations.translation: 这样的警告需要我们重视【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
The weather service issued a warning about the storm.
He ignored the warning about the dangers of AI.
The machine broke down without warning.

synonyms.example: The UN is urging caution over the use of the new technology.
synonyms.usage: caution 兼指“告诫”和“谨慎”，语气正式；warning 侧重“预先示警”，更常见。

synonyms.example: The system sent out a security alert.
synonyms.usage: alert 多指系统/官方发出的即时警报（a security/red alert）；warning 更泛用。

advancedExpressions.expression: warn (v.) → warning (n.)；warn sb (not) to do；give a warning
advancedExpressions.example: He warned us not to trust the message — but we ignored his warning.

advancedExpressions.expression: without (any) warning 毫无预兆地
advancedExpressions.example: The power went off without warning during the exam.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: These warnings are important, so we should pay attention to them.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 demand our attention 替换 we should pay attention to，主动名词化更凝练。

classPractice.question: Apparently, such ______ (warn) demand our attention.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词复数，warn 的名词形式为 warning。

classPractice.question: The old computer suddenly broke down ______ ______ (毫无预兆).
classPractice.note: without warning 毫无预兆地。

classPractice.question: 改写：He warned us. → He gave us a ______.
classPractice.note: give sb a warning = warn sb，动词转名词表达。

translation: vt. 强烈要求；需要，要求（具备）【课件】；n. 要求；（顾客的）需求
original_sentence: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
definitionEn: to ask for something very firmly; to need something in order to be done successfully.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 需要（具备），要求（人力、时间等）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: This sport demands both speed and strength.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （顾客的）需求，需要（可数/不可数）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: There's an increased demand for organic produce these days.

posExamples.example: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
posExamples.translation: 显然，这样的警告需要得到我们的重视。

posExamples.example: She demanded an immediate explanation from the manager.
posExamples.translation: 她要求经理立即做出解释。

posExamples.example: Demand is exceeding supply in the local market.
posExamples.translation: 当地市场供不应求。

collocations.translation: 需要我们的重视【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
I demand that John (should) go there at once.
He demanded to see the manager.
There's an increased demand for organic food these days.
Good secretaries are always in demand.
The factory worked hard to meet market demands.

synonyms.example: This job requires patience and skill.
synonyms.usage: require 语气较客观（require + n./that 从句用虚拟）；demand 语气更强硬，含“强烈要求”。

synonyms.example: Passengers are requested to fasten their seat belts.
synonyms.usage: request 委婉客气；demand 强硬。二者后接 that 从句都用 (should) do 虚拟。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·demand 后从句的虚拟语气
advancedExpressions.expression: demand/require/order/insist + that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形
advancedExpressions.example: She demanded that the report (should) be finished at once.

advancedExpressions.expression: the demand for sth / in demand / by popular demand / meet demands
advancedExpressions.example: By popular demand, the play will run for another week.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: We should pay attention to such warnings because they are important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Apparently, such warnings demand our attention.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 demand our attention 主动化名词短语替换 we should pay attention to。

classPractice.question: I demand that ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ (John 马上去那儿).
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：demand that sb (should) do sth，虚拟语气。

classPractice.question: She ______ ______ ______ ______ (强烈要求立即道歉).
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：demand + n. 强烈要求某物。

classPractice.question: It is reported that ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ (这个地区非常需要教师).
classPractice.answer: teachers are in demand in this area
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：in demand 需求大。

classPractice.question: Get the technology that has proved to help even the most ______ (demand) customers.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：需形容词“要求高的”，用 demanding。

translation: n. 受害者，遇害者，牺牲品
original_sentence: There is growing concern that we might fall victim to this technology.
definitionEn: someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （受某种情况/偏见等所害的）牺牲品
uncommonMeanings.example: She was a victim of racial prejudice.

posExamples.example: There is growing concern that we might fall victim to this technology.
posExamples.translation: 人们越来越担心我们可能会沦为这项技术的受害者。

posExamples.example: Volunteers rushed to help the earthquake victims.
posExamples.translation: 志愿者们赶去帮助地震灾民。

collocations.translation: 沦为……的受害者，深受……之害【课件】
collocations.example: We might fall victim to this technology if we are careless.

collocations.translation: 事故/地震的受害者【课件】
collocations.example: The hospital was full of accident victims.
He was a victim of racial prejudice.
Charities are working hard to help the flood victims.

synonyms.example: The medicine brings relief to cancer sufferers.
synonyms.usage: sufferer 侧重“长期忍受痛苦/疾病者”（常与病名连用）；victim 侧重“受某一事件/行为伤害者”。

synonyms.example: The accident caused several casualties.
synonyms.usage: casualty 特指事故/战争中的伤亡人员，常用复数；victim 范围更广。

advancedExpressions.expression: fall victim to sth / a victim of sth / accident victims
advancedExpressions.example: Many small shops fell victim to the economic crisis.

advancedExpressions.expression: victim / sufferer / casualty / the injured
advancedExpressions.example: Rescuers worked all night to save the casualties.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: People are more and more worried that this technology may harm us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is growing concern that we might fall victim to this technology.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 fall victim to 替换 harm us，there is growing concern that 引出忧虑，更书面。

classPractice.question: If we are not careful, we might ______ ______ ______ this technology.
classPractice.note: fall victim to sth 沦为……的受害者。

classPractice.question: 许多小商店成了这场经济危机的牺牲品。
classPractice.answer: Many small shops fell victim to the economic crisis.
classPractice.note: fall victim to sth 深受……之害。

classPractice.question: The rescue team worked all night to save the ______ (victims / sufferers) of the earthquake.
classPractice.note: 受某一事件（地震）伤害者用 victims。

translation: adj. 贪婪的，贪心的；贪吃的
original_sentence: He stared at the diamonds with greedy eyes.
definitionEn: wanting more money, power, food, etc. than you really need.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 贪吃的，嘴馋的
uncommonMeanings.example: Don't be so greedy — leave some cake for the others.

posExamples.example: He stared at the diamonds with greedy eyes.
posExamples.translation: 他用贪婪的目光盯着那些钻石。

posExamples.example: Some people are greedy for money and power.
posExamples.translation: 有些人贪求金钱和权力。

collocations.example: He was greedy for power and wealth.
He stared at the diamonds with greedy eyes.
Nothing would satisfy her greed for power.

synonyms.example: It was selfish of him to keep all the profit.
synonyms.usage: selfish 强调“只顾自己、不顾他人”；greedy 强调“贪多、想要超出所需”。二者常作表语或前置定语。

synonyms.translation: 物质至上的，贪图物质的
synonyms.example: He is too materialistic to care about others' feelings.
synonyms.usage: materialistic 侧重“重视物质金钱”；greedy 语气更贬、更直接。

advancedExpressions.expression: greed (n.) → greedy (adj.) → greedily (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: Driven by greed, he made one greedy decision after another.

advancedExpressions.expression: be greedy for sth 贪求某物
advancedExpressions.example: A greedy person is never greedy for just enough.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He looked at the diamonds. He wanted them very much.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He stared at the diamonds with greedy eyes.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 with greedy eyes 伴随状语替换 wanted them very much，画面感更强。

classPractice.question: Nothing would satisfy her ______ (greedy) for power.
classPractice.note: her 后需名词，greedy 的名词形式为 greed。

classPractice.question: Some people are always ______ ______ (贪求) money and power.
classPractice.note: be greedy for sth 贪求某物。

classPractice.question: 他用贪婪的目光盯着那些珠宝。
classPractice.answer: He stared at the jewels with greedy eyes.
classPractice.note: with greedy eyes 用贪婪的目光。

translation: 略举几例，仅举几例（用作插入语，句中或句尾）【课件】
original_sentence: Nowadays, AI is already being applied in many fields: finance, health care, machine translation and art, to name but a few.
definitionEn: used after a list of examples to say that there are many more that you could mention.

posExamples.example: AI is applied in finance, health care and art, to name but a few.
posExamples.translation: AI 被应用于金融、医疗、艺术等领域，这里仅举几例。

posExamples.example: Bees and bats, to name but a few, can see what humans can't.
posExamples.translation: 蜜蜂和蝙蝠等（仅举几例）能看到人类看不到的东西。

collocations.translation: ……等，仅举几例（列举后加此插入语）【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: Nowadays, AI is applied in many fields: finance, health care and art, to name but a few.
The city has many famous sites — the Bell Tower and the City Wall, to name just a few.

synonyms.example: We bought apples, oranges, bananas and so on.
synonyms.usage: and so on 口语常用、较随意；to name but a few 更书面、更强调“可举例子还有很多”，常作插入语。

synonyms.example: The plan was supported by teachers and parents, among others.
synonyms.usage: among others 指“众多之中的（这些）”；to name but a few 用于列举结尾示例。

advancedExpressions.expression: to name but a few / to name (just) a few / and so on / among others / just to name a couple
advancedExpressions.example: Many great scientists — Einstein and Newton, to name but a few — changed the world.

advancedExpressions.expression: 在举例后插入 to name but a few，避免 and so on 的随意感
advancedExpressions.example: AI now helps in medicine, transport and education, to name but a few.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: AI is used in many fields, such as finance, health care and art, and so on.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: AI is now applied in many fields — finance, health care and art, to name but a few.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 to name but a few 替换 and so on，书面感与高级度更高。

classPractice.question: AI is used in finance, health care and art, ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ (略举几例).
classPractice.note: 列举后用插入语 to name but a few 表‘仅举几例’。

classPractice.question: 许多伟大的科学家，如爱因斯坦和牛顿，仅举几例，改变了世界。
classPractice.answer: Many great scientists, such as Einstein and Newton, to name but a few, changed the world.
classPractice.note: to name but a few 作插入语，两侧用逗号。

classPractice.question: 把 and so on 升级：The library has novels, magazines and comics and so on. → ... and comics, ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
classPractice.note: 用 to name but a few 替换 and so on，更书面。

translation: 沦为……的受害者，深受……之害【课件】
original_sentence: Moreover, there is growing concern that we might fall victim to this technology, as there are cases in which hackers have broken into facial recognition systems by using people's social media photos to build models of their faces.
definitionEn: to be harmed or badly affected by something or someone.

posExamples.example: There is growing concern that we might fall victim to this technology.
posExamples.translation: 人们越来越担心我们可能会沦为这项技术的受害者。

posExamples.example: Many small businesses fell victim to the financial crisis.
posExamples.translation: 许多小企业成了金融危机的牺牲品。

collocations.translation: 沦为……的受害者【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: We might fall victim to this technology if we are not careful.
Elderly people often fall victim to online scams.
Thousands fell victim to the disease during the outbreak.

synonyms.example: Careless users may fall prey to hackers.
synonyms.usage: fall prey to 与 fall victim to 近义，均接名词；prey 更强调“被捕食/被利用”意象。

synonyms.example: Many people suffer from the misuse of personal data.
synonyms.usage: suffer from 强调“持续遭受痛苦/疾病”；fall victim to 强调“沦为受害者”这一结果。

advancedExpressions.expression: fall victim to sth = fall prey to sth 沦为……的受害者
advancedExpressions.example: Without protection, users can easily fall victim to online fraud.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in which 引导的定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: cases in which hackers have broken into ... = cases where hackers have broken into ...
advancedExpressions.example: There are cases in which hackers steal people's photos to build face models.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: People worry that this technology may harm us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is growing concern that we might fall victim to this technology.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 fall victim to 替换 be harmed by，there is growing concern that 引出普遍担忧。

classPractice.question: Elderly people who are not familiar with the Internet may easily ______ ______ ______ online scams.
classPractice.note: fall victim to sth 沦为……的受害者。

classPractice.question: 许多小企业成了这场经济危机的牺牲品。
classPractice.answer: Many small businesses fell victim to the economic crisis.
classPractice.note: fall victim to sth 深受……之害。

classPractice.question: 改写：Careless users may be harmed by hackers. → Careless users may ______ ______ ______ hackers.
classPractice.note: 用 fall victim to 表被害，替换 be harmed by。

translation: n. 识别，辨认【课件】；承认，认可；赞誉，赏识
original_sentence: There are cases in which hackers have broken into facial recognition systems by using people's social media photos to build models of their faces.
definitionEn: the act of recognizing or identifying someone or something; public praise and reward for someone's work or achievement; the act of accepting that something is true or important.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 承认，认可（acknowledgement）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: There is a general recognition of the urgent need for reform.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 赞誉，赏识（public praise）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: She gained only minimal recognition for her work.

posExamples.example: Hackers have broken into facial recognition systems using people's photos.
posExamples.translation: 黑客利用人们的照片入侵了人脸识别系统。

posExamples.example: He glanced at her, but there was no sign of recognition.
posExamples.translation: 他扫了她一眼，却没有一点认出她的迹象。

posExamples.example: They received recognition for their long commitment to safety at sea.
posExamples.translation: 他们因长期致力于海上安全而获得认可。

collocations.translation: 人脸识别【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: Hackers have broken into facial recognition systems.
He was rewarded in recognition of his contributions to education.
The town has changed beyond recognition since I was last here.
She received recognition for her outstanding research.
He looked at me with no sign of recognition.

synonyms.example: The award was an acknowledgement of her hard work.
synonyms.usage: acknowledgement 侧重“公开承认（事实/贡献）”；recognition 兼含“识别”与“认可、赏识”，义项更广。

synonyms.example: Fingerprint identification is widely used by the police.
synonyms.usage: identification 侧重“确认身份/鉴定”（identify）；recognition 侧重“认出（此前见过的）”。

advancedExpressions.expression: recognize (v.) → recognition (n.) → recognizable (adj.)；be recognized as 被公认为
advancedExpressions.example: The film is now recognized as a classic.

advancedExpressions.expression: in recognition of / beyond recognition / gain recognition for / facial recognition
advancedExpressions.example: They were rewarded in recognition of their 20-year commitment to safety at sea.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The old town has changed so much that I can hardly know it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old town has changed beyond recognition.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 beyond recognition 替换 changed so much that I can hardly know it，凝练有力。

classPractice.question: The town has changed ______ ______ (认不出来) since I was last here.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：beyond recognition（变得）认不出来。

classPractice.question: He is rewarded ______ ______ ______ (对……的肯定) his contributions to education.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：in recognition of sth 为表彰/肯定……。

classPractice.question: Hackers have broken into facial ______ (recognize) systems using stolen photos.
classPractice.note: facial 后需名词，recognize 的名词形式为 recognition。

translation: 数据库；资料库
original_sentence: AI systems can search a huge database and analyse massive amounts of data in seconds.
definitionEn: a large amount of information stored in a computer system in such a way that it can be easily looked at or changed.

posExamples.example: All the customers' details are stored in a central database.
posExamples.translation: 所有客户的资料都存储在一个中央数据库里。

wordForms.meaning: 数据；资料（database 由 data+base 合成）

collocations.example: The company built a huge database of user preferences.
It took years to build a database of every plant species.
You can search the database by name or date.
All the records are stored in a secure database.

synonyms.example: The hospital keeps a data bank of donors.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，与 database 近义，指集中存储的资料集合

advancedExpressions.expression: database = data（数据）+ base（基地/基础）
advancedExpressions.example: 类比 network = net + work、breakthrough = break + through。

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The computer keeps a lot of information.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The computer maintains a vast database of information that can be searched in seconds.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 database 替换笼统的 a lot of information，更专业地道

classPractice.question: All the students' records are stored in a central ____ (data).
classPractice.note: database 为 data+base 合成的名词，此处作 stored in 的宾语

classPractice.question: 这家公司建立了一个庞大的用户信息数据库。
classPractice.answer: The company (has) built a huge database of user information.
classPractice.note: build a database 建立数据库；of 引出数据库的内容

classPractice.question: You can quickly ____ the whole database by typing in a keyword. (search / research)
classPractice.note: search a database 检索数据库；research 意为“研究”不搭配

translation: 【课件】n. 可供选择的事物，替代选择；adj. 可替代的，非传统的
original_sentence: New ways to treat this disease may provide an alternative to painkillers.
definitionEn: something you can choose to do or use instead of something else; (adj.) that can be used instead of sth else; different from what is usual or traditional.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 非传统的，另类的
uncommonMeanings.example: Many young people are attracted to alternative lifestyles and values.

posExamples.example: We had no alternative but to fire Gibson.
posExamples.translation: 我们除了解雇吉布森别无选择。

posExamples.example: Alternative energy such as solar power has come into widespread use.
posExamples.translation: 太阳能等替代（清洁）能源已开始广泛使用。

collocations.example: New ways to treat this disease may provide an alternative to painkillers.

collocations.phrase: have no alternative but to do sth
collocations.translation: 除了做某事别无选择（课件搭配，=have no option but to do）
collocations.example: We had no alternative but to fire Gibson.

collocations.translation: 替代能源，清洁能源（课件搭配）
collocations.example: Alternative energy has come into widespread use.

collocations.translation: 非传统的生活方式／价值观（课件搭配）
collocations.example: She chose an alternative lifestyle far from the city.

collocations.phrase: an alternative method/way of doing sth
collocations.example: Is there an alternative method of learning this?

synonyms.example: We have no option but to accept the offer.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，have no option but to do = have no alternative but to do，后接 to do

synonyms.example: You are left with little choice in the matter.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，泛指“选择”，可数

advancedExpressions.expression: have no alternative but to do = have no option but to do = can do nothing but do sth
advancedExpressions.example: We had no alternative but to / had no option but to postpone the meeting.

advancedExpressions.expression: alter（改变）→ alternative（可替代的/替代品）、alternate（交替的）、alternatively（或者）
advancedExpressions.example: If plan A fails, we can alternatively try plan B.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: We must fire him. There is nothing else to do.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We have no alternative but to fire him.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 have no alternative but to do 表“别无选择”，比 nothing else to do 更书面

classPractice.question: New treatments may provide an ____ (另一种选择) ____ painkillers.
classPractice.note: an alternative to sth：……的替代选择，介词固定用 to

classPractice.question: We had no choice but to cancel the trip. → We had no ____ but to cancel the trip.
classPractice.note: have no alternative/option but to do sth 别无选择，只能……

classPractice.question: 清洁（替代）能源已开始广泛使用。
classPractice.answer: Alternative energy has come into widespread use.
classPractice.note: alternative energy 替代能源／清洁能源；come into widespread use 广泛使用

translation: 【课件】n. 黑客（非法侵入他人电脑系统的人）
original_sentence: There are cases in which hackers have broken into facial recognition systems by using people's social media photos to build models of their faces.
definitionEn: a person who secretly gets access to a computer system in order to get information or cause damage.

posExamples.example: Hackers have broken into the company's database and stolen customers' data.
posExamples.translation: 黑客侵入了公司的数据库，窃取了客户的数据。

wordForms.meaning: 非法侵入（计算机系统）；砍，劈

collocations.translation: 黑客侵入某系统（课件原句搭配）
collocations.example: Hackers have broken into facial recognition systems using stolen photos.
A computer hacker stole thousands of passwords.
Someone hacked into the bank's network overnight.

synonyms.example: Cybercriminals target online banking users.
synonyms.usage: 作名词，泛指利用网络犯罪的人，比 hacker 更强调“犯罪”

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-er 施动者后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: hack（v. 非法侵入）+ -er → hacker（做该动作的人）
advancedExpressions.example: 类比 program→programmer、design→designer。

advancedExpressions.example: 类比：airway（航道）、airport（机场）、airmail（航空邮件），均以 air- 构成。

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The airline uses AI. It predicts delays.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The airline uses AI to predict flight delays, saving passengers hours of waiting.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用不定式表目的 + 现在分词短语表结果，句子更紧凑。

classPractice.question: Several major ____ (airline) have adopted AI systems to reduce flight delays.
classPractice.note: several 后接可数名词复数。

classPractice.question: 这家航空公司利用人工智能预测航班延误。
classPractice.answer: The airline uses AI to predict flight delays.
classPractice.note: predict flight delays 为固定搭配。

classPractice.question: He compared ticket prices from three different ____ before booking. (airlines / airports)
classPractice.note: 买机票比价针对的是航空公司 airline，而非机场 airport。

translation: 【课件】威胁，凶兆；恐吓；构成威胁的人（物）
original_sentence: Some experts urge us to think about the dangers posed by the advances in AI, which may threaten the existence of humans.
definitionEn: a statement or situation showing that something bad or dangerous may happen; a person or thing likely to cause harm.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 凶兆；不祥之兆（预示坏天气等）
uncommonMeanings.example: There is a threat of rain in those dark clouds.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 构成威胁的人或事物
uncommonMeanings.example: Hackers are seen as a serious threat to online privacy.

posExamples.example: Advances in AI may pose a threat to human jobs.
posExamples.translation: 人工智能的进步可能对人类的工作构成威胁。

wordForms.meaning: 威胁的，恐吓的；（天气）即将来临的

collocations.example: Drugs pose a major threat to our society.

collocations.translation: 面临危险，受到……的威胁【课件】
collocations.example: These ancient woodlands are under threat from new road developments.
He was arrested for making threats against a witness.

collocations.translation: 空洞的威胁；虚张声势【课件】
collocations.example: His father threatened to throw him out, but he knew it was an empty threat.
She was born with a life-threatening heart abnormality.

synonyms.example: The chemical poses a danger to workers' health.
synonyms.usage: 作可数/不可数名词；pose a danger/threat to sth 结构相同，threat 更强调有意造成的危害。

synonyms.example: Careless drivers are a menace to pedestrians.
synonyms.usage: 书面语色彩更强；a menace to sb/sth 指令人不安的威胁。

advancedExpressions.expression: pose a threat to / be under threat from / make threats against / a threat to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: AI could pose a threat to privacy, leaving personal data under threat from hackers.

advancedExpressions.expression: pose a threat to = present a danger to = put ... at risk = endanger
advancedExpressions.example: Reckless AI use may endanger / put at risk our personal safety.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: AI is dangerous to human jobs.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: AI poses a growing threat to human jobs.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 pose a threat to 替换 be dangerous to，更书面、更精准。

classPractice.question: There are several things you can do to defend your home against this ____ (threaten).
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：介词 against 后需名词 threat。

classPractice.question: It is said that many precious species are under ____ from human activities.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：固定搭配 under threat from 面临……的威胁。

classPractice.question: His father threatened to throw him out, but he knew it was an empty ____ (threaten).
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：an empty threat 空洞的威胁，需名词形式。

classPractice.question: 毒品对我们的社会构成重大威胁。
classPractice.answer: Drugs pose a major threat to our society.
classPractice.note: pose a major threat to 为课件核心搭配。

translation: 【课件】vi. 暗中监视，从事间谍活动；vt. 突然看见；n. 间谍，密探
original_sentence: With facial recognition everywhere, some might spy on and take photographs of others without their knowledge.
definitionEn: to watch someone secretly in order to get information; (noun) a person who secretly collects information about a country or organization.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 突然看见，发现（尤指经过寻找后）
uncommonMeanings.example: She spied her friend's face in the crowd and waved.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 间谍，密探
uncommonMeanings.example: The middle-aged man who had been caught denied that he was a spy.

posExamples.example: The neighbours accused the camera of spying on them.
posExamples.translation: 邻居们指责这个摄像头在暗中监视他们。

posExamples.example: The novel tells the story of a spy during the war.
posExamples.translation: 这部小说讲述了战争期间一名间谍的故事。

collocations.example: The boy came here to spy on the enemy's movements.

collocations.translation: 间谍飞机／间谍卫星【课件】
collocations.example: The country was accused of sending a spy plane over the border.

collocations.translation: 在远处突然看见某物【课件】
collocations.example: In the distance we spied the Pacific for the first time.
He was arrested for spying for a foreign government.

synonyms.example: The guards watched the prisoners closely.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，直接跟宾语；spy 表暗中监视时须接 on（spy on sb）。

synonyms.example: The system monitors network traffic day and night.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，多指用设备持续监控；spy 更强调秘密偷窥。

advancedExpressions.expression: spy on sb（暗中监视）/ spy sth（突然看见）/ a spy plane（间谍飞机）
advancedExpressions.example: The satellite could spy on cities below, and analysts soon spied unusual movements.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·spy on 与 without one's knowledge
advancedExpressions.expression: spy on and take photographs of others without their knowledge（在别人不知情的情况下）
advancedExpressions.example: Some might spy on others without their knowledge = without others knowing about it.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Some people secretly watch others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Some might spy on others without their knowledge.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 spy on + without one's knowledge 表达“暗中、在不知情下监视”，更贴合课文。

classPractice.question: 那个男孩来这里是为了监视敌人的行动。
classPractice.answer: The boy came here to spy on the enemy's movements.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：spy on 暗中监视。

classPractice.question: 那个被抓起来的中年男人不承认自己是间谍。
classPractice.answer: The middle-aged man who had been caught denied that he was a spy.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：spy 作名词“间谍”，denied that ...。

classPractice.question: The satellite is designed to ____ (spy) on enemy activities from high above.
classPractice.note: to 后接动词原形；spy on 暗中监视。

translation: 非法的，违法的
original_sentence: It is illegal to use people's facial data to build models without their permission.
definitionEn: not allowed by the law; against the law.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （计算机）不被程序允许的，非法的（指指令、操作）
uncommonMeanings.example: The program stopped after an illegal operation.

posExamples.example: It is illegal to break into others' facial recognition systems.
posExamples.translation: 闯入他人的人脸识别系统是违法的。

collocations.phrase: It is illegal to do sth
collocations.example: It is illegal to collect personal data without consent.
Hackers use these tools for illegal activities online.
The government took new measures against illegal immigration.
The new law made such practices illegal.

synonyms.example: The court ruled that the search was unlawful.
synonyms.usage: 较正式书面语；作定语或表语，与 illegal 近义。

synonyms.example: Downloading these files is against the law.
synonyms.usage: 作表语的短语，语气较口语化；illegal 更简洁常用。

advancedExpressions.expression: il- + legal → illegal（否定前缀 in- 在 l 前变 il-）
advancedExpressions.example: 类比：il + legible → illegible（难以辨认的）、il + literate → illiterate（文盲的）。

sentenceUpgrade.simple: You can't collect people's face data without permission.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is illegal to collect people's facial data without their permission.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 It is illegal to do sth 句型，正式且强调法律层面。

classPractice.question: It is ____ (legal) to access others' private data without permission.
classPractice.note: 语境为“违法的”，加否定前缀 il-。

classPractice.question: 未经许可收集人脸数据是违法的。
classPractice.answer: It is illegal to collect facial data without permission.
classPractice.note: It is illegal to do sth 句型。

classPractice.question: The two hackers were caught downloading the software ____ (illegal).
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 downloading，用副词形式。

translation: vt. 监控，监测；vi. 监听；n. 监视器，显示器；班长
original_sentence: These smart systems can monitor traffic in large cities and adjust the signals in real time.
definitionEn: to watch and check something over a period of time in order to see how it develops.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 监视器；（电脑）显示器
uncommonMeanings.example: A row of monitors displayed images from every camera.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 班长；级长
uncommonMeanings.example: As class monitor, she collected everyone's homework.

posExamples.example: AI cameras can monitor a stadium and spot danger instantly.
posExamples.translation: 人工智能摄像头能监控整个体育场并即时发现危险。

posExamples.example: The nurse watched the patient's data on the monitor.
posExamples.translation: 护士在监视器上观察病人的数据。

collocations.example: Doctors will monitor her progress over the next few weeks.
The system closely monitors network traffic for any unusual activity.

collocations.translation: 心脏监护仪／婴儿监视器
collocations.example: A heart monitor recorded every change in his pulse.
She looked up from the computer monitor and rubbed her eyes.

synonyms.example: Scientists observe the animals' behaviour in the wild.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，强调观察记录；monitor 更强调长期、持续地检查以掌握变化。

synonyms.example: The app tracks how much data each program uses.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，强调追踪动态变化；与 monitor 常可互换。

advancedExpressions.expression: monitor sth（监测）/ closely monitor（密切监控）/ monitoring system（监控系统）
advancedExpressions.example: A smart monitoring system can closely monitor traffic and warn of accidents.

advancedExpressions.expression: monitor = keep track of = keep an eye on = watch closely
advancedExpressions.example: The AI keeps track of / keeps an eye on every device on the network.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The system watches the traffic all the time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The system monitors the traffic in real time and adjusts the signals automatically.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 monitor + in real time 表达“实时监控”，更专业地道。

classPractice.question: Smart cameras are used to ____ (monitor) the traffic in busy city centres.
classPractice.note: be used to do sth，to 后接动词原形。

classPractice.question: 医生会在接下来几周监测她的康复情况。
classPractice.answer: Doctors will monitor her progress over the next few weeks.
classPractice.note: monitor one's progress 监测进展。

classPractice.question: A nurse kept watching his data on the ____. (monitor / warning)
classPractice.note: 此处指显示数据的“监视器”monitor。

translation: 体育场，运动场
original_sentence: AI-powered cameras in the stadium can identify troublemakers in the crowd within seconds.
definitionEn: a large sports ground with rows of seats all around it for a large crowd of spectators.

posExamples.example: Facial recognition helps security teams monitor the whole stadium.
posExamples.translation: 人脸识别帮助安保团队监控整个体育场。

wordForms.meaning: stadium 的常用复数（亦作 stadia）
stadium 的拉丁语复数（正式）

collocations.example: The new football stadium can hold eighty thousand fans.
Excited fans filled the stadium hours before the match.
She sang before a packed stadium of forty thousand people.
The city built a modern stadium for the games.

synonyms.example: The concert was held in a huge indoor arena.
synonyms.usage: 作可数名词，多指有屋顶的室内场馆；stadium 多为露天大型体育场。

synonyms.example: The team played its first match on the new ground.
synonyms.usage: 英式英语中 sports ground/football ground 指球场；stadium 规模更大、有看台。

advancedExpressions.expression: stadium 的复数：stadiums（常用）或 stadia（拉丁词源）
advancedExpressions.example: 类比 medium→media、datum→data，源自拉丁语的名词常有 -a 复数。

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Many people came to the stadium to watch the game.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A packed stadium of forty thousand fans roared as the game began.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 a packed stadium of + 数字，画面感更强。

classPractice.question: The city has built two new sports ____ (stadium) for the coming games.
classPractice.note: two 后接可数名词复数，stadiums。

classPractice.question: 兴奋的球迷在比赛前几个小时就坐满了体育场。
classPractice.answer: Excited fans filled the stadium hours before the match.
classPractice.note: fill the stadium 坐满体育场。

classPractice.question: The smart cameras can scan the whole ____ and spot danger in seconds. (stadium / airline)
classPractice.note: 语境指“体育场”，选 stadium。

translation: 【课件】大量地，大批地
original_sentence: When passenger drones are flying above our cities in large quantities, the sky will become a busy highway.
definitionEn: in large amounts or numbers.

posExamples.example: Solar panels are now produced in large quantities at low cost.
posExamples.translation: 如今太阳能电池板正被大批量低成本地生产。

collocations.example: When passenger drones are flying above our cities in large quantities, traffic will change forever.
It's cheaper to buy goods in quantity.
A large quantity of washing machines has been sold.
Large quantities of sand were washed down the hill by the rain.
Only a small quantity of water is needed for the seeds.

synonyms.example: Drones now appear in large numbers over big cities.
synonyms.usage: number 只修饰可数名词；quantity 可数不可数皆可，故 in large quantities 适用范围更广。

synonyms.example: The product is now manufactured on a large scale.
synonyms.usage: 作状语，强调规模；in large quantities 强调数量之多。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·quantity 的主谓一致
advancedExpressions.expression: A large quantity of + 名词 → 谓语随 quantity 单数；Large quantities of + 名词 → 谓语用复数
advancedExpressions.example: A large quantity of washing machines HAS been sold. / Large quantities of sand WERE washed down. 谓语依 quantity 单复数而定，与 amount 相同。

advancedExpressions.expression: in large quantities = in quantity = in large amounts = in bulk
advancedExpressions.example: Buying in bulk / in large quantities usually lowers the unit price.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: There will be a lot of drones flying above our cities.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When passenger drones are flying above our cities in large quantities, the sky will become a busy highway.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 in large quantities 替换 a lot of，作状语，句式更书面。

classPractice.question: Solar panels are now produced ____ ____ ____ (大量地) at a very low cost.
classPractice.note: 作状语，表“大量地生产”。

classPractice.question: A large quantity of new drones ____ (be) tested in the city this month.
classPractice.note: PPT要点：谓语随 quantity 单数，a large quantity of 后用单数谓语。

classPractice.question: 当载人无人机大批量地在城市上空飞行时，天空将变得繁忙。
classPractice.answer: When passenger drones are flying above our cities in large quantities, the sky will become busy.
classPractice.note: in large quantities 作状语，紧扣课文原句。

translation: 【课件】暗中监视，窥探
original_sentence: With facial recognition everywhere, some might spy on and take photographs of others without their knowledge.
definitionEn: to watch someone secretly in order to find out what they are doing.

posExamples.example: Smart cameras should protect us, not spy on us.
posExamples.translation: 智能摄像头应当保护我们，而非暗中监视我们。

wordForms.meaning: 从事间谍活动；突然看见

collocations.translation: 暗中监视某人／某物【课件】
collocations.example: Some might spy on and take photographs of others without their knowledge.

collocations.translation: 暗中监视敌人的行动【课件】
collocations.example: The boy came here to spy on the enemy's movements.

collocations.phrase: spy on sb without their knowledge
collocations.translation: 在某人不知情的情况下监视其【课件】
collocations.example: It is wrong to spy on people without their knowledge.

synonyms.example: Could you keep an eye on my bag for a moment?
synonyms.usage: 作短语动词，多为“帮忙照看”，中性；spy on 强调秘密偷窥，含贬义。

synonyms.example: He felt someone was watching him secretly from the car.
synonyms.usage: 短语，与 spy on 意义相近，spy on 更简洁固定。

advancedExpressions.expression: spy on sb（暗中监视）vs spy sth（突然看见）vs spy for sb（为某方当间谍）
advancedExpressions.example: Cameras that spy on citizens differ from a hiker who suddenly spies a deer in the woods.

advancedExpressions.expression: spy on = keep secret watch on = monitor secretly = snoop on
advancedExpressions.example: Apps that snoop on / spy on users' locations raise privacy concerns.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Some people secretly watch and photograph others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Some might spy on and take photographs of others without their knowledge.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 spy on 精准表达“暗中监视”，紧扣课文原句。

classPractice.question: 那个男孩来这里是为了监视敌人的行动。
classPractice.answer: The boy came here to spy on the enemy's movements.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：spy on 暗中监视。

classPractice.question: It is against the law to ____ ____ people and film them without their knowledge.
classPractice.note: spy on sb 暗中监视某人。

classPractice.question: Some might secretly watch others without their knowing. → Some might ____ ____ others without their knowledge.
classPractice.note: secretly watch = spy on。

translation: n. 最精彩的部分，最重要的部分；vt. 强调，突出；用彩笔标出
original_sentence: The opening of the time capsule was one of the highlights of the celebration.
definitionEn: the best, most interesting or most exciting part of something; (verb) to emphasize something or make it easy to notice.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 用荧光笔／彩笔标出（文字）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please highlight any words you don't understand.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （头发上挑染的）浅色发绺（常用复数 highlights）
uncommonMeanings.example: She had blonde highlights put in her hair.

posExamples.example: The VR demonstration was the highlight of the technology fair.
posExamples.translation: 虚拟现实演示是这次科技展会最精彩的部分。

posExamples.example: The article highlights how AI can change our daily lives.
posExamples.translation: 这篇文章强调了人工智能会如何改变我们的日常生活。

wordForms.meaning: highlight 的复数；精彩片段集锦

collocations.example: Meeting the scientist was the highlight of the whole trip.
The report highlights the importance of protecting personal data.
The accident highlighted the dangers of driverless cars.
She highlighted the key points in yellow before the exam.

synonyms.example: The teacher emphasized the need for regular practice.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词；highlight 作动词时与 emphasize 近义，还可指“用彩笔标出”。

synonyms.example: The main feature of the show was a live robot dance.
synonyms.usage: 作名词指“显著特色”；highlight 作名词更强调“最精彩、最难忘的部分”。

advancedExpressions.expression: highlight = high（高的）+ light（光）→ 使某物“亮”出来
