advancedExpressions.expression: the highlight of sth（最精彩部分）/ highlight the importance of（强调……重要性）
advancedExpressions.example: The report highlights the risks; for many readers that was the highlight of the discussion.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Opening the time capsule was the best part of the celebration.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The opening of the time capsule was one of the highlights of the celebration.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 one of the highlights of 替换 the best part，表达更地道。

classPractice.question: The VR show was one of the ____ (highlight) of the whole fair.
classPractice.note: one of the 后接可数名词复数。

classPractice.question: 这份报告强调了保护个人数据的重要性。
classPractice.answer: The report highlights the importance of protecting personal data.
classPractice.note: highlight the importance of doing sth。

classPractice.question: The teacher asked us to ____ the key words in yellow. (highlight / bury)
classPractice.note: 用彩笔标出关键词用 highlight。

translation: n. 太空舱；（药物的）胶囊；密封容器
original_sentence: The time capsule, buried 50 feet below the ground in a park, was designed to be opened in the year 6939.
definitionEn: a small container; a small case holding medicine that you swallow; the part of a spacecraft in which people live and work.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （药物的）胶囊
uncommonMeanings.example: Each capsule contains a small dose of the medicine.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （航天器上载人的）密封舱，太空舱
uncommonMeanings.example: The capsule splashed safely into the ocean.

posExamples.example: People placed photos and letters inside the time capsule.
posExamples.translation: 人们把照片和信件放进这个时间胶囊里。

collocations.translation: 时间胶囊（埋藏物品供后人开启）【课件】
collocations.example: The time capsule was designed to be opened in the year 6939.
The astronauts returned to Earth in the space capsule.
The doctor told her to take one capsule after each meal.
The students buried a capsule full of letters to future pupils.

synonyms.example: The seeds were sealed in an airtight container.
synonyms.usage: 作可数名词，泛指容器；capsule 特指小型密封的容器/舱/胶囊。

synonyms.example: The escape pod carried the crew to safety.
synonyms.usage: 作可数名词，多指可分离的小舱；与 capsule 在“太空舱”义相近。

advancedExpressions.expression: a time capsule（时间胶囊）/ a space capsule（太空舱）/ take a capsule（服胶囊）
advancedExpressions.example: From a swallowed capsule to a space capsule, the word covers any small sealed container.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: People put things in a box and buried it for the future.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: People sealed their memories in a time capsule and buried it for future generations.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 time capsule + seal，形象贴合课文话题。

classPractice.question: The students buried a time ____ (capsule) full of letters to future pupils.
classPractice.note: time capsule 时间胶囊，此处为单数。

classPractice.question: 宇航员们乘坐太空舱返回地球。
classPractice.answer: The astronauts returned to Earth in the space capsule.
classPractice.note: space capsule 太空舱。

classPractice.question: The doctor told her to take one ____ after each meal. (capsule / fountain)
classPractice.note: 服药用“胶囊”capsule。

translation: 【课件】vt. 埋，埋藏；掩埋，遮盖；把（脸、手等）埋进；隐藏（感情）；安葬
original_sentence: The time capsule, buried 50 feet below the ground in a park, was designed to be opened in the year 6939.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把（脸、手）埋进；把……深深插入
uncommonMeanings.example: He walked slowly, his hands buried in his pockets.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 隐藏，藏起（感情、记忆）
uncommonMeanings.example: Deeply-buried memories came flooding back.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 安葬，埋葬（死者）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was buried at the top of a hill.

posExamples.example: The seeds were buried deep in the soil before winter.
posExamples.translation: 冬天到来前，种子被深埋在土壤里。

wordForms.meaning: 被埋藏的（buried treasure 埋藏的宝藏）

idioms.idiom: bury one's head in the sand
idioms.meaning: 逃避现实，采取鸵鸟政策
idioms.example: You can't just bury your head in the sand and ignore the problem.

collocations.phrase: be buried below / under the ground
collocations.example: The time capsule was buried 50 feet below the ground in a park.

collocations.phrase: bury one's face in one's hands
collocations.example: He buried his face in his hands and wept.

collocations.translation: 专心致志于某事，埋头于【课件】
collocations.example: They buried themselves in their work and forgot the time.

collocations.phrase: have one's head buried in a book
collocations.example: She always has her head buried in a book.
He learned to bury his feelings and stay calm.
Your letter got buried under a pile of papers.

synonyms.example: She hid the letter under a pile of books.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，泛指藏起；bury 强调“埋入/盖住使不可见”。

synonyms.example: He tried to conceal his disappointment.
synonyms.usage: 作及物动词，书面语；bury one's feelings 与 conceal one's feelings 近义。

advancedExpressions.expression: bury sth（埋藏）/ bury one's face in（把脸埋进）/ bury oneself in sth（埋头于）/ bury one's feelings（隐藏感情）
advancedExpressions.example: He buried his face in his hands, then buried himself in work to bury his grief.

advancedExpressions.expression: bury oneself in sth = be absorbed in = be immersed in = throw oneself into
advancedExpressions.example: She buried herself in / immersed herself in the research for months.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: They worked very hard and forgot everything else.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: They buried themselves in their work and forgot the passing of time.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 bury oneself in sth 表达“埋头、专心于”，更生动。

classPractice.question: 他被安葬在一座小山的山顶上。
classPractice.answer: He was buried at the top of a hill.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：bury 表“安葬”，用被动。

classPractice.question: 那所房子被掩埋在十英尺厚的雪下面。
classPractice.answer: The house was buried under ten-foot snow.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：be buried under sth 被……掩埋。

classPractice.question: 他们埋头于工作。
classPractice.answer: They buried themselves in their work.
classPractice.note: PPT语境应用原题：bury oneself in sth 埋头于某事。

classPractice.question: The time capsule, ____ (bury) deep below the ground, will be opened in 6939.
classPractice.note: 与逻辑主语 capsule 是被动关系，用过去分词作后置定语。

translation: n. 喷泉，喷水池；喷射的水流；源泉，泉源
original_sentence: Among the objects sealed inside the time capsule were an old fountain pen and photos of the city's famous fountain.
definitionEn: a structure from which water is pumped up into the air as a decoration; a strong flow of liquid going up into the air.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 喷射而出的水流（或其他液体、火花等）
uncommonMeanings.example: A fountain of water shot up when the pipe burst.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 源泉，泉源（比喻大量提供某物的人或事物）
uncommonMeanings.example: The library is a fountain of ideas for young writers.

posExamples.example: The old fountain in the city centre still runs every evening.
posExamples.translation: 市中心那座古老的喷泉每天傍晚仍在喷水。

wordForms.meaning: 钢笔，自来水笔（合成短语）

idioms.meaning: 青春之泉（传说中能使人永葆青春的泉水）
idioms.example: People have long dreamed of finding the fountain of youth.

collocations.example: Children love to play near the water fountain in the square.
She signed the letter with an old fountain pen.
My grandfather was a fountain of knowledge about local history.
There is a drinking fountain at the end of the corridor.

synonyms.example: The sun is our main source of energy.
synonyms.usage: 作可数名词，泛指来源；fountain 作比喻义“源泉”时更形象（a fountain of wisdom）。

synonyms.example: The village gets its water from a mountain spring.
synonyms.usage: 作可数名词，指天然涌出的泉水；fountain 多指人工喷泉。

advancedExpressions.expression: a water fountain（喷泉）/ a fountain pen（钢笔）/ a fountain of knowledge（知识源泉）
advancedExpressions.example: By the fountain in the square, she wrote with a fountain pen, a real fountain of ideas.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: My grandfather knew a lot about local history.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: My grandfather was a fountain of knowledge about local history.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 a fountain of knowledge 比喻“知识源泉”，表达更生动。

classPractice.question: Children love to play near the water ____ (fountain) in the square.
classPractice.note: 此处为单数名词“喷泉”。

classPractice.question: 她用一支旧钢笔在信上签了名。
classPractice.answer: She signed the letter with an old fountain pen.
classPractice.note: fountain pen 钢笔。

classPractice.question: My grandfather was a real ____ of knowledge about our town. (fountain / capsule)
classPractice.note: a fountain of knowledge 知识的源泉。

translation: 当代的，现代的【课件】；同时期的，同时代的【课件】；n. 同辈人，同时代的人【课件】
original_sentence: Perhaps he should have a more updated look, a more contemporary style that appeals to today's young users.
definitionEn: belonging to the present time (modern), or belonging to the same period of time as someone or something else; (n.) a person living at the same time as another

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 同时期的，同一时代的（be contemporary with sb/sth）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: He was contemporary with the famous dramatist Shakespeare.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 同辈人，同时代的人（常用复数 contemporaries）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: Like most of my contemporaries, I grew up in a vastly different world.

posExamples.example: The museum holds a rich collection of contemporary art created after 2000.
posExamples.translation: 这座博物馆收藏了大量 2000 年后创作的当代艺术作品。

posExamples.example: He was a contemporary of mine at university.
posExamples.translation: 他是我大学时的同学（同辈人）。

wordForms.meaning: 当代的；同时期的；同辈人
临时的，暂时的（形近词，勿混）

collocations.translation: 当代艺术／现代风格【课件】
collocations.example: She prefers contemporary art to the old masters.
The documentary explores everyday life in contemporary Britain.

collocations.translation: 与……同时期，与……同时代【课件】
collocations.example: These cave paintings are contemporary with the earliest farming villages.

collocations.translation: 同辈人，同时代的人【课件】
collocations.example: Like most of my contemporaries, I embraced the smartphone at once.
Contemporary technology such as AI is reshaping how we live and work.

synonyms.example: The gallery is famous for its modern architecture.
synonyms.usage: adj.，作前置定语或表语；指现代的、新式的，范围比 contemporary 广，可泛指近代以来。

synonyms.example: The report reflects the current state of AI research.
synonyms.usage: adj.，多作前置定语；强调"眼下正在发生／通行的"，不含"同时代"义。

synonyms.example: We use up-to-date sensors to track the athletes' movements.
synonyms.usage: adj.，作表语或前置定语；侧重信息／技术"最新、不过时"。

advancedExpressions.expression: contemporary 当代的／同时期的（con-一起 + tempor 时间）vs temporary 临时的、暂时的
advancedExpressions.example: A temporary exhibition of contemporary art opened in the hall this week.

advancedExpressions.expression: contemporary（同时代的）/ temporary（临时的）/ temporarily（暂时地），词根 tempor- = time
advancedExpressions.example: The contemporary artist took a temporary job to fund her projects.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Many people today use AI in their daily life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In contemporary society, AI has quietly woven itself into people's daily routines.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 in contemporary society 替代 today，更书面、更贴合科技议论文开头。

classPractice.question: The gallery is best known for its ________ art, most of which was created in the past ten years. （contemporary / temporary）
classPractice.note: 指"当代的"用 contemporary；temporary 意为"临时的"，语义不符。

classPractice.question: Like most of my ________ (contemporary), I grew up in a world without smartphones.
classPractice.note: 作名词"同辈人"讲，常用复数 contemporaries。

classPractice.question: 这些壁画与最早的农耕村落属于同一时期。（be contemporary with）
classPractice.answer: These wall paintings are contemporary with the earliest farming villages.
classPractice.note: "与……同时期"用 be contemporary with sth。

classPractice.question: 他曾主张，这位画家应该拥有更时尚、更 ________（当代的）风格。He argued that the painter should have a more fashionable, more ________ style.
classPractice.note: 此处"当代的、现代的"取 contemporary 的 modern 义。

translation: 种子；n. （比喻）起源，根源，开端；vt. & vi. 播种，结籽
original_sentence: The agricultural robot can plant seeds, pull up weeds and water the crops all on its own.
definitionEn: a small hard object produced by a plant from which a new plant can grow; (figurative) the beginning or origin from which something develops

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）起源，根源，开端（the seeds of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Their early experiments planted the seeds of the virtual reality industry.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （体育比赛的）种子选手
uncommonMeanings.example: The top seed advanced easily to the final.

posExamples.example: Farmers now use smart machines to sow seeds far more evenly than by hand.
posExamples.translation: 农民现在用智能机器播种，比手工播种均匀得多。

posExamples.example: The drone can seed a whole field in a matter of minutes.
posExamples.translation: 这架无人机几分钟内就能给整片田地播种。

wordForms.meaning: 去籽的；（比赛中）被列为种子的

idioms.meaning: 埋下……的种子，播下……的祸根／希望
idioms.example: Reckless use of AI may sow the seeds of new social problems.

collocations.example: In spring the machine plants seeds row by row across the field.
His talk planted the seeds of curiosity about robotics in the students.

collocations.translation: （植物）结籽；（人或物）变得破败、走下坡路
collocations.example: Without care, the once-tidy garden had run to seed.

synonyms.example: A single grain of wheat can grow into a whole plant.
synonyms.usage: n.，多指谷物的籽实（尤指小麦、稻米）；seed 泛指一切植物的种子。

synonyms.example: The origin of the idea can be traced back to the 1980s.
synonyms.usage: n.，用于比喻义时与 the seeds of 相近；origin 更抽象、正式。

advancedExpressions.expression: plant/sow seeds 播种 → sow the seeds of 埋下……的种子 → go to seed 走下坡路
advancedExpressions.example: Early breakthroughs sowed the seeds of today's AI, though some feared it would let society go to seed.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The robot puts seeds in the ground and pulls out weeds.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Operating entirely on its own, the agricultural robot plants seeds and pulls up weeds without any human help.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 加 operating entirely on its own 状语，突出机器人的自主性，贴合科技主题。

classPractice.question: Working on its own, the smart machine plants ________ (seed) and waters the crops.
classPractice.note: 泛指多颗种子用复数 seeds。

classPractice.question: His inspiring lecture ________ the ________ of interest in AI among the students. （播下……的种子）
classPractice.note: sow/plant the seeds of sth = 埋下……的种子。

classPractice.question: 这架无人机几分钟内就能给整片田地播种。（seed 作动词）
classPractice.answer: The drone can seed the whole field in a few minutes.
classPractice.note: seed 可作动词表"播种"。

translation: 小麦；小麦粒（不可数名词，作物或磨成面粉的谷物）
original_sentence: With the help of AI, the robot can tell ripe wheat from weeds and harvest it at exactly the right time.
definitionEn: a cereal plant that is the source of the flour used for bread, pasta, etc.; the grain of this plant

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 麦田里的麦子（作物整体，不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: Fields of golden wheat stretched to the horizon.

posExamples.example: Sensors on the robot help it decide exactly when the wheat is ready to be harvested.
posExamples.translation: 机器人上的传感器帮它判断小麦究竟何时可以收割。

posExamples.example: This country exports large quantities of wheat every year.
posExamples.translation: 这个国家每年出口大量小麦。

idioms.idiom: separate the wheat from the chaff
idioms.meaning: 去粗取精，分辨精华与糟粕
idioms.example: A good AI filter helps us separate the wheat from the chaff online.

collocations.example: Robots can now harvest wheat around the clock.
The drone flew over a vast field of ripening wheat.
Bread is usually made from wheat flour.

synonyms.example: Wheat is one of the world's most important grains.
synonyms.usage: n.，泛指谷类粮食的总称；wheat 是其中一种具体谷物。

synonyms.example: The main crop in this region is wheat.
synonyms.usage: n.，指某季种植收获的作物；wheat 是具体的一种 crop。

advancedExpressions.expression: wholewheat = whole + wheat 全麦的；wheatfield = wheat + field 麦田
advancedExpressions.example: She switched to wholewheat bread for her health.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The robot knows which is wheat and which is weeds.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Guided by AI, the robot can accurately tell ripe wheat from weeds and harvest it at the right moment.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 tell A from B（分辨）与 guided by AI 状语，表达更精确、地道。

classPractice.question: The robot can tell ripe ________ from weeds and harvest it at the right time. （wheat / weed）
classPractice.note: 根据"成熟可收割"语义，选 wheat（小麦）；weed 是杂草。

classPractice.question: 这个国家每年出口大量小麦。（in large quantities）
classPractice.answer: This country exports wheat in large quantities every year.
classPractice.note: wheat 为不可数名词，不加复数。

classPractice.question: A good filter helps us separate the ________ from the chaff online. （去粗取精）
classPractice.note: 习语 separate the wheat from the chaff = 去粗取精。

translation: 肌肉发达的，强壮的；肌肉的，与肌肉有关的
original_sentence: The new robot is designed with strong, muscular arms so that it can lift heavy loads with ease.
definitionEn: having well-developed muscles and looking strong; of or relating to the muscles

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 肌肉的，与肌肉有关的（medical use）
uncommonMeanings.example: The patient suffers from a rare muscular disease.

posExamples.example: The robot's muscular limbs allow it to carry heavy machine parts on the factory floor.
posExamples.translation: 这台机器人肌肉般强健的臂膀让它能在车间搬运沉重的机器部件。

posExamples.example: Years of training gave the athlete a lean and muscular body.
posExamples.translation: 多年训练使这名运动员拥有精瘦而结实的身材。

wordForms.meaning: 肌肉发达的（=muscular，多作后置修饰）

collocations.translation: 强健的臂膀／结实的身体
collocations.example: The android was built with muscular arms strong enough to lift a car.
The exoskeleton greatly increases the wearer's muscular strength.
Doctors hope AI will help diagnose muscular disorders earlier.

synonyms.example: The robot's strong arms never grow tired.
synonyms.usage: adj.，泛指有力量；muscular 特指"肌肉发达而显得强壮"，偏外形。

synonyms.example: The machine stands on four sturdy legs.
synonyms.usage: adj.，多形容身体或物体结实耐用；muscular 只用于肌肉／体格。

synonyms.example: The security guard was a tall, well-built man.
synonyms.usage: adj.，形容人体格匀称健壮，常作表语或前置定语。

advancedExpressions.expression: muscle n.（肌肉）→ muscular adj.（肌肉发达的）→ muscular strength（肌肉力量）
advancedExpressions.example: Regular exercise builds muscle and gives the body muscular strength.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The robot has strong arms and can lift heavy things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Fitted with muscular arms, the robot can lift heavy loads with ease.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用形容词 muscular 与 with ease 短语，表达更凝练、生动。

classPractice.question: Years of training gave the athlete a lean and ________ (muscle) body.
classPractice.note: 此处需形容词修饰 body，用 muscle 的形容词 muscular。

classPractice.question: The robot's ________ arms are strong enough to lift a car. （muscle / muscular）
classPractice.note: 作定语修饰 arms 用形容词 muscular。

classPractice.question: 这台机器人肌肉般强健的臂膀让它能搬运沉重的部件。
classPractice.answer: The robot's muscular arms allow it to carry heavy parts.
classPractice.note: muscular arms = 强健的臂膀。

translation: 得出结论，断定；（使）结束，终止；缔结，达成（协议等）
original_sentence: After studying the data for weeks, the researchers concluded that AI could greatly improve farming efficiency.
definitionEn: to decide or believe something as a result of reasoning; to (cause to) end; to arrange or settle something formally (e.g. an agreement)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （使）结束，终止（conclude with sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The speaker concluded her talk with a warning about the risks of AI.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 缔结，达成（协议、条约等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The two companies concluded a deal to develop the new robot together.

posExamples.example: From the experiment we can conclude that the sensor works even in the dark.
posExamples.translation: 从实验中我们可以断定这个传感器在黑暗中也能工作。

posExamples.example: The report concludes with several suggestions for future research.
posExamples.translation: 这份报告以几条对未来研究的建议结尾。

idioms.idiom: come to / reach / draw a conclusion
idioms.example: After the tests, we drew the conclusion that the system was safe.

collocations.example: The scientists concluded that the robot needed no human control.
What can we conclude from these results?
She concluded her speech with a memorable quotation.

collocations.translation: 总之，最后（写作常用过渡语）
collocations.example: In conclusion, AI will reshape our future in countless ways.

synonyms.example: From the footprints, the detective deduced that two people had been there.
synonyms.usage: vt.，deduce sth from sth；强调由已知逻辑推理得出，比 conclude 更侧重推理过程。

synonyms.example: She finished her talk on time.
synonyms.usage: vt./vi.，普通用词表"结束"；conclude 更正式，多用于讲话、报告、协议。

synonyms.example: We can infer from the graph that sales are rising.
synonyms.usage: vt.，infer sth from sth；由证据间接推知，语气比 conclude 更谨慎。

advancedExpressions.expression: conclude v. → conclusion n.（结论/结尾）→ concluding adj.（结尾的）→ conclusive adj.（确凿的）
advancedExpressions.example: In her concluding remarks she reached a conclusion supported by conclusive evidence.

advancedExpressions.expression: conclude that / come to the conclusion that / draw the conclusion that / it can be concluded that
advancedExpressions.example: It can be concluded that AI raises efficiency but also brings new risks.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The researchers thought AI could make farming better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: After weeks of study, the researchers concluded that AI could greatly improve farming efficiency.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 conclude that 替代 thought，更书面、更适合报告与议论文。

classPractice.question: As it now stands, the report ________ (conclude) with several suggestions for future research.
classPractice.note: as it now stands 指"就目前而言"，用一般现在时；主语 report 第三人称单数，故用 concludes。

classPractice.question: 从这些结果中我们可以断定这个系统是安全的。From these results we can ________ ________ the system is safe.
classPractice.note: conclude that + 从句 = 断定……。

classPractice.question: ________ ________, AI will reshape our future in countless ways. （总之，写作过渡语）
classPractice.note: in conclusion = 总之，用于结尾段。

classPractice.type: 用指定语法形式完成句子
classPractice.question: It can be ________ (conclude) that AI raises efficiency but also brings new risks.
classPractice.note: It can be concluded that ... 为被动客观表达"可以得出结论"。

translation: 有正当理由的，合乎情理的，正当的
original_sentence: Many people feel their worries about AI taking over jobs are fully justified.
definitionEn: having a good reason for existing or being done; reasonable and acceptable

uncommonMeanings.meaning: be justified in doing sth：有正当理由做某事
uncommonMeanings.example: Are we justified in trusting machines with such important decisions?

posExamples.example: Their fears about privacy proved fully justified when hackers stole the data.
posExamples.translation: 当黑客窃取了数据，他们对隐私的担忧被证明完全合乎情理。

posExamples.example: The company felt justified in spending so much on AI research.
posExamples.translation: 公司觉得在人工智能研究上投入这么多是有正当理由的。

wordForms.meaning: 可证明为正当的，情有可原的

collocations.translation: 做某事是有正当理由的
collocations.example: Users are justified in worrying about how their photos are used.

collocations.translation: 完全正当的，完全合乎情理的
collocations.example: Her complaint about the faulty sensor was fully justified.
There is a justified concern that AI may spread false information.

synonyms.example: It is reasonable to worry about data safety.
synonyms.usage: adj.，作表语或前置定语；泛指"合理的、说得通的"，语气比 justified 平和。

synonyms.example: Such strong measures are not warranted.
synonyms.usage: adj.（较正式），常作表语；强调"值得、有必要"，与 justified 近义。

advancedExpressions.expression: justify v.（证明正当）→ justified adj.（正当的）→ justification n.（正当理由）→ justifiable adj.（情有可原的）
advancedExpressions.example: He tried to justify his choice, but no justification could make it seem justified.

advancedExpressions.expression: justified 指"（已有充分理由而）正当的、被证明合理的"；justifiable 指"（本身）可辩解的、情有可原的"
advancedExpressions.example: Her anger was justified, and even her harsh words were justifiable.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: People think their worries about AI are correct.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Many people feel their worries about AI taking over jobs are fully justified.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 be fully justified 替代 are correct，表达"完全合乎情理"，更书面。

classPractice.question: Users are ________ (justify) in worrying about how their private data is used.
classPractice.note: be justified in doing sth = 有正当理由做某事，用过去分词形容词 justified。

classPractice.question: 当黑客窃取了数据，他们的担忧被证明完全合乎情理。Their fears proved fully ________ when hackers stole the data.
classPractice.note: proved + adj. 结构，justified 作表语。

classPractice.question: The company felt fully ________ (justify) in spending so much on AI research.
classPractice.note: feel justified in doing sth = 觉得做某事是正当的；此处需过去分词形容词 justified，唯一正确。

translation: 优越（性），优势【课件】；优越感，高人一等的态度【课件】
original_sentence: Even as humans fear the superiority of the machines, our species remains the ideal to which they aspire.
definitionEn: the quality of being better, more powerful, or more effective than others; the belief that you are better than other people

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 优越感，高人一等的姿态（an air/sense of superiority）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: His constant sense of superiority makes him very unpopular.

posExamples.example: The company demonstrated the superiority of its operating system over its rivals'.
posExamples.translation: 这家公司展示了它的操作系统相对于对手的优越性。

posExamples.example: For years the country enjoyed clear technological superiority in AI.
posExamples.translation: 多年来这个国家在人工智能领域享有明显的技术优势。

wordForms.meaning: 更好的，占优势的；上级，长官
劣势，低等；自卑（反义词）【课件】

collocations.translation: A（相对于 B）的优越性【课件】
collocations.example: No one can deny the superiority of this operating system.

collocations.phrase: have / establish / show superiority over sb in sth
collocations.translation: 在某方面比……有优势【课件】
collocations.example: The new chip establishes clear superiority over older models in speed.

collocations.translation: 一副神气活现的样子；优越感【课件】
collocations.example: She spoke with an air of superiority that annoyed everyone.
The nation is determined to keep its technological superiority in AI.

synonyms.example: Speed is the robot's greatest advantage over human workers.
synonyms.usage: n.，have an advantage over sb；泛指"有利之处"，比 superiority 中性，无"高人一等"贬义。

synonyms.example: The firm has achieved dominance in the smart-device market.
synonyms.usage: n.，强调"支配、统治"般的绝对优势，程度比 superiority 更强。

advancedExpressions.expression: superior adj.（优于……）→ superiority n.（优势）↔ inferior adj.（差于……）→ inferiority n.（劣势）
advancedExpressions.example: This model is technically superior to its rivals; its superiority makes competitors feel inferior.

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析·be superior to / be inferior to
advancedExpressions.expression: be superior to sb/sth（优于，注意用 to 不用 than）↔ be inferior to sb/sth（不如，比不上）
advancedExpressions.example: Modern music is not necessarily inferior to that of the past; some pieces are clearly superior to it.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: This system is better than the others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: No one can deny the superiority of this system over its rivals.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用名词 superiority 与 the superiority of A over B 结构，比 better than 更书面、更有力。

classPractice.question: This model is technically ________ (superiority) to its competitors.
classPractice.note: 空处需形容词并接 to，用 superior；be superior to = 优于。

classPractice.question: 没有人能否认这种操作系统的优越性。No one can deny the ________ of this operating system.
classPractice.note: the superiority of sth = ……的优越性。

classPractice.question: She spoke with an air of ________, looking down on everyone. （superiority / inferiority）
classPractice.note: "看不起别人"体现优越感，用 superiority；inferiority 是自卑。

classPractice.question: 这款新芯片在速度上明显优于旧型号。（establish superiority over）
classPractice.answer: The new chip establishes clear superiority over older models in speed.
classPractice.note: establish superiority over sb/sth in sth = 在某方面确立对……的优势。

translation: 钢笔，自来水笔（用墨水书写的笔）
original_sentence: Among the objects sealed in the time capsule was an old fountain pen once used by a famous writer.
definitionEn: a pen with a container of ink inside it that flows to the nib as you write

posExamples.example: In the age of touchscreens, a fountain pen feels wonderfully old-fashioned.
posExamples.translation: 在触屏时代，一支钢笔让人觉得格外复古。

posExamples.example: Grandfather still signs important letters with his silver fountain pen.
posExamples.translation: 爷爷仍用他那支银色钢笔签署重要信件。

wordForms.meaning: 钢笔，自来水笔（合成名词 fountain+pen）

collocations.example: She loves to write letters with a fountain pen.
He carefully refilled his fountain pen with blue ink.

synonyms.example: May I borrow your pen for a moment?
synonyms.usage: n.，泛指各类笔；fountain pen 特指灌墨水的钢笔，比 ballpoint pen（圆珠笔）书写更顺滑。

advancedExpressions.expression: fountain（喷泉→墨水源源不断）+ pen（笔）= fountain pen 自来水笔；类比 ballpoint pen 圆珠笔
advancedExpressions.example: A fountain pen draws ink up like a fountain, while a ballpoint pen uses a tiny rolling ball.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: There was an old pen in the box.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Among the objects sealed in the time capsule was an old fountain pen once used by a famous writer.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 Among ... was 倒装与 once used by ... 分词定语，句式更丰富。

classPractice.question: 在触屏时代，一支钢笔让人觉得格外复古。
classPractice.answer: In the age of touchscreens, a fountain pen feels wonderfully old-fashioned.
classPractice.note: fountain pen = 钢笔、自来水笔。

classPractice.question: She loves writing letters with a ________, dipping the nib gently into the ink. （fountain pen / touchscreen）
classPractice.note: 由"nib（笔尖）、ink（墨水）"可知选 fountain pen。

classPractice.question: 在时间胶囊里封存的物品中，有一支曾属于著名作家的旧钢笔。Among the objects in the time capsule was an old ________ ________ once owned by a famous writer.
classPractice.note: fountain pen 为合成名词"钢笔"，两空分别填 fountain 与 pen。

translation: （计算机）虚拟的，模拟的【课件】；实质上的，几乎……的（但未被正式承认）
original_sentence: Jaron Lanier was at the forefront of developments in virtual reality in the 1980s.
definitionEn: made to appear to exist by the use of computer software (e.g. virtual reality); almost or nearly the thing described, but not completely or officially

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 实质上的，事实上的，几乎……的（尚未被正式承认）
uncommonMeanings.example: The new device brought a virtual end to the use of paper maps.

posExamples.example: With a headset on, players are transported into a fully virtual world.
posExamples.translation: 戴上头显后，玩家便被带入一个完全虚拟的世界。

posExamples.example: The signing of the contract was a virtual certainty after months of talks.
posExamples.translation: 经过数月谈判后，合同的签署几乎已成定局。

collocations.example: Virtual reality allows students to walk through ancient Rome in the classroom.
Gamers spend hours exploring a richly detailed virtual world.
The museum now offers a virtual tour for visitors abroad.

collocations.phrase: at the forefront of developments in virtual reality
collocations.translation: 处于虚拟现实开发的前沿【课件】
collocations.example: The lab is at the forefront of developments in virtual reality.

synonyms.example: Pilots train in a simulated cockpit before real flights.
synonyms.usage: adj.，多作前置定语；指"用技术模拟出来的"，与 virtual 的"计算机虚拟"义相近。

synonyms.translation: 实际上的，事实上的（近 virtual 的"实质"义）
synonyms.example: He is the practical head of the company, though not the official one.
synonyms.usage: adj.，for all practical purposes = 实际上；与 virtual 的"几乎、实质上"义可互换。

advancedExpressions.expression: virtual adj.（虚拟的/实质的）→ virtually adv.（几乎；实际上）→ virtual reality n.（虚拟现实）
advancedExpressions.example: Virtually every classroom could soon use virtual reality to make learning immersive.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·at the forefront of（介词短语作表语/状语）
advancedExpressions.expression: be at the forefront of sth = 处于……的前沿／最前沿；也可 at the forefront of one's mind 萦绕心头
advancedExpressions.example: His team is at the forefront of scientific research into virtual reality.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: In the 1980s Jaron Lanier led work on virtual reality.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Jaron Lanier was at the forefront of developments in virtual reality in the 1980s.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 be at the forefront of developments in 替代 led，更地道、更书面。

classPractice.question: With a headset on, players are transported into a fully ________ (virtual) world.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 world 用形容词 virtual。

classPractice.question: The new app made paper maps ________ obsolete — almost no one uses them now. （virtually / actually）
classPractice.note: virtually = 几乎，差不多；与"almost no one"呼应。

classPractice.question: 拉尼尔处于虚拟现实开发的最前沿。Lanier was at the ________ of developments in ________ reality.
classPractice.note: at the forefront of = 处于……前沿；virtual reality = 虚拟现实。

classPractice.question: 这座博物馆如今为海外游客提供虚拟参观。（virtual tour）
classPractice.answer: The museum now offers a virtual tour for visitors abroad.
classPractice.note: virtual tour = 虚拟参观。

translation: 定义，释义【课件】；（图像、声音的）清晰度，清晰程度【课件】
original_sentence: The idea of "virtual reality", to be sure, will not sit still for an easy definition.
definitionEn: a statement of the exact meaning of a word or phrase; the degree of clearness and sharpness of an image, sound, etc.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （图像、屏幕、声音的）清晰度，清晰程度【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: The definition of the digital TV pictures is excellent.

posExamples.example: A textaholic can be defined as someone who is addicted to sending messages.
posExamples.translation: "短信控"可以被定义为沉迷于收发信息的人。

posExamples.example: The dictionary gives a clear definition of every technical term.
posExamples.translation: 这本词典给每个技术术语都下了清晰的定义。

wordForms.meaning: 给……下定义；阐明，界定；描出……的外形【课件】

collocations.example: The article offers a clear definition of artificial intelligence.
A robot is, by definition, a machine that can perform tasks automatically.
A textaholic can be defined as someone addicted to messaging.
The headset displays the virtual world in stunning high definition.

synonyms.example: Look up the meaning of the word in a dictionary.
synonyms.usage: n.，泛指"含义"；definition 特指对词语精确、完整的"释义、下定义"。

synonyms.translation: 清晰，清楚（近 definition 的"清晰度"义）
synonyms.example: The new screen offers remarkable clarity.
synonyms.usage: n.，指图像／表达的清晰；与 definition 的"清晰度"义相通。

advancedExpressions.expression: define v.（下定义/界定）→ definition n.（定义/清晰度）→ definite adj.（明确的）→ definitely adv.（肯定地）
advancedExpressions.example: We need to define the term clearly, for a vague definition helps no one.

advancedExpressions.expression: define sth as / describe sth as / A is defined as / by definition
advancedExpressions.example: Virtual reality is defined as a computer-generated world users can seem to enter.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: It is hard to say exactly what virtual reality means.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The idea of "virtual reality", to be sure, will not sit still for an easy definition.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 will not sit still for an easy definition 拟人化表达"难以简单下定义"，更生动。

classPractice.question: A textaholic can be ________ (definition) as someone who is addicted to sending messages.
classPractice.note: 此处需动词，用 be defined as = 被定义为；definition 是其名词。

classPractice.question: The ________ of the digital TV pictures is excellent — every detail is sharp. （definition / meaning）
classPractice.note: 指画面"清晰度"用 definition，不用 meaning。

classPractice.question: A robot is, ________ ________, a machine that can perform tasks automatically. （根据定义）
classPractice.note: by definition = 根据定义，从定义上说。

translation: 头戴式设备，头显；耳机（带话筒的头戴式耳麦）
original_sentence: By putting on a VR headset, users can feel as if they are standing inside a completely different world.
definitionEn: a device worn over the head, especially a pair of headphones with a microphone, or a display worn over the eyes for virtual reality

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （带麦克风的）头戴式耳机，头戴受话器
uncommonMeanings.example: The call-centre staff all wear headsets so their hands are free.

posExamples.example: She slipped on the headset and was instantly surrounded by a virtual forest.
posExamples.translation: 她戴上头显，立刻被一片虚拟森林包围。

posExamples.example: Modern VR headsets are lighter and more comfortable than earlier models.
posExamples.translation: 如今的 VR 头显比早期型号更轻便、更舒适。

wordForms.meaning: 头戴式设备；头显；耳麦（合成词 head+set）

collocations.example: Put on the headset and the virtual world comes to life around you.

collocations.translation: VR 头显，虚拟现实头戴设备
collocations.example: A VR headset can trick your brain into feeling you have moved.
He answered the call through his wireless headset while driving.

synonyms.example: She listened to music through her headphones.
synonyms.usage: n.（常复数），只用于听声音；headset 通常还带麦克风或含显示屏（如 VR headset）。

advancedExpressions.expression: headset = head（头）+ set（一套设备）；类比 handset 听筒、headphone 耳机
advancedExpressions.example: A VR headset combines a display and headphones into one head-worn set.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: When you wear a VR headset, you feel like you are in another world.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By putting on a VR headset, users can feel as if they are standing inside a completely different world.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 by doing 状语与 feel as if 从句，表达更连贯、地道。

classPractice.question: 她戴上头显，立刻被一片虚拟森林包围。（put on a headset）
classPractice.answer: She put on the headset and was instantly surrounded by a virtual forest.
classPractice.note: put on a headset = 戴上头显。

classPractice.question: To enter the virtual world, you first need to put on a VR ________. （headset / keyboard）
classPractice.note: 进入虚拟世界需戴 VR 头显 headset。

classPractice.question: The call-centre staff wear ________ so they can talk and type at the same time. （headsets / headphones）
classPractice.note: 需带麦克风且能通话，用 headset（耳麦）；headphones 只能听。

translation: 传感器，感应器（探测光、热、声、运动等并作出反应的装置）
original_sentence: The headset is fitted with sensors that track the movement of the user's head and hands.
definitionEn: a device that detects or measures a physical property such as light, heat, sound, or motion and responds to it

posExamples.example: Motion sensors let the game respond the instant you wave your hand.
posExamples.translation: 运动传感器让游戏在你一挥手的瞬间就作出反应。

posExamples.example: The self-driving car uses dozens of sensors to "see" the road.
posExamples.translation: 这辆自动驾驶汽车用几十个传感器来"看清"道路。

collocations.example: A motion sensor switches on the light when someone walks in.
The robot is equipped with sensors that detect obstacles.

collocations.phrase: a sensor detects / picks up sth
collocations.example: The sensor detects even the smallest change in temperature.

synonyms.example: A smoke detector will sound an alarm if it senses smoke.
synonyms.usage: n.，侧重"探测到某物并示警"（如 smoke/metal detector）；sensor 侧重"感知并传回信号"。

advancedExpressions.expression: sense n./v.（感知）→ sensor n.（传感器）→ sensitive adj.（灵敏的）→ sensor + -ry 相关 sensory adj.（感官的）
advancedExpressions.example: A sensitive sensor can sense the faintest touch and turn it into a signal.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The headset has sensors that follow how your head and hands move.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The headset is fitted with sensors that track the movement of the user's head and hands.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 be fitted with 与 track the movement of 替代口语化表达，更书面、精确。

classPractice.question: The self-driving car uses dozens of ________ (sensor) to "see" the road.
classPractice.note: dozens of 后接可数名词复数，用 sensors。

classPractice.question: A motion ________ switches on the light the moment someone walks in. （sensor / screen）
classPractice.note: 能探测运动并触发反应的装置是 sensor（传感器）。

classPractice.question: 这个机器人装有能探测障碍物的传感器。（be equipped with sensors）
classPractice.answer: The robot is equipped with sensors that detect obstacles.
classPractice.note: be equipped/fitted with sensors = 装有传感器。

translation: 【课件】实用的，切实可行的；务实的，理智的（人）；实际的，实事求是的 adj.
original_sentence: Virtual reality already has a host of practical applications, ranging from education and health care to entertainment.
definitionEn: connected with real situations rather than with ideas or theories; likely to be effective and appropriate; sensible and realistic in your approach to a situation.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 切实可行的，行得通的（workable, effective）
uncommonMeanings.example: It wouldn't be practical for us to go all that way just for the weekend.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 务实的，理智的（形容人；sensible）
uncommonMeanings.example: My friend Peter is very practical and down to earth.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 实际的，实事求是的（realistic）
uncommonMeanings.example: Let's be practical and work out the cost first.

posExamples.example: Our clothes are lightweight, fashionable and practical for holidays.
posExamples.translation: 我们的衣服轻便、时尚，很适合度假穿。

wordForms.meaning: 不切实际的，不现实的（反义词）

idioms.example: The sale was supposed to last for a week, but for all practical purposes it's over.
In practical terms, this new rule changes very little for us.

collocations.example: Virtual reality already has a host of practical applications.
These boots are practical for hiking in the mountains.
Let's be practical and work out the cost first.

synonyms.example: We need a realistic plan, not a dream.
synonyms.usage: 作定语或表语；describe attitudes/plans，强调符合实际

synonyms.example: The engineers came up with a workable solution.
synonyms.usage: 作定语/表语；describe plans/ideas，强调可实施

advancedExpressions.expression: impractical (opp.) / practically (adv. 几乎) / for all practical purposes (实际上)
advancedExpressions.example: By the 1920s, wolves had practically disappeared from the Yellowstone area.

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-al 形容词后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: practice (n.) → practical (adj.)：名词加 -al 变形容词，同类 nature→natural, medicine→medical
advancedExpressions.example: A practical mind values what works over what merely sounds good.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: VR can be used in many real situations.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: VR already has a host of practical applications, ranging from education to health care.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 practical applications + ranging from…to… 提升表达的正式度与信息密度。

classPractice.question: It wouldn't be ____ for us to go all that way just for the weekend. (practical / theoretical)
classPractice.note: practical 指切实可行、值得去做，符合语境。

classPractice.question: By the 1920s, wolves had ____ (practical) disappeared from the Yellowstone area.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 disappeared，需用副词 practically，此处义为「几乎（almost）」。

classPractice.question: 咱们务实一点，先把成本算出来。
classPractice.answer: Let's be practical and work out the cost first.
classPractice.note: be practical 表「务实、理智」，固定搭配 work out 计算得出。

translation: 学术的，学业的，教学的 adj.；（问题）纯理论的，空谈的 adj.；大学教师，学者 n.
original_sentence: VR can enhance academic performance by making abstract concepts easier to understand.
definitionEn: connected with education, especially studying in schools and universities; based on ideas and theories rather than practical effects.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纯理论的，脱离实际的，空谈的（不太可能发生因而不值得讨论）
uncommonMeanings.example: Whether he stays or leaves is purely academic now that the project is cancelled.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 大学教师；学者，研究人员
uncommonMeanings.example: Several leading academics were invited to give lectures on AI.

posExamples.example: She has an excellent academic record throughout high school.
posExamples.translation: 她整个高中的学业成绩都非常出色。

collocations.example: VR can enhance academic performance by making learning more engaging.
The new academic year begins in September.
Parents place great value on their children's academic achievement.

synonyms.example: The museum offers many educational programmes for students.
synonyms.usage: 作定语；侧重「与教育活动相关」，academic 侧重「学术、学业」

synonyms.example: The debate remained purely theoretical.
synonyms.usage: 作定语/表语；与 academic「纯理论的」义相近，强调非实践

advancedExpressions.expression: academic performance / academic record / academic year / academic pressure
advancedExpressions.example: Heavy academic pressure can affect a student's mental health.

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ic 形容词后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: academy (n.) → academic (adj.)：-ic 表「……的」，同类 history→historic, science→scientific
advancedExpressions.example: Her academic interests lie in cognitive science.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: VR helps students study better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: VR can enhance academic performance by turning abstract concepts into vivid experiences.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 enhance academic performance 替换 study better，书面语更学术。

classPractice.question: The technology has helped many students improve their ____ (academy) performance.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 performance 需用形容词 academic。

classPractice.question: Now that the plan has been cancelled, the question of who leads it is purely ____. (academic / practical)
classPractice.note: 此处 academic 取「纯理论的、不值得讨论的」熟词僻义。

classPractice.question: 沉浸式技术能提高学生的学业成绩。
classPractice.answer: Immersive technology can improve/enhance students' academic performance.
classPractice.note: academic performance 固定搭配，指学业成绩。

translation: 【课件】沉浸式的，身临其境的 adj.
original_sentence: Immersive technology allows users to feel as if they were truly present in a computer-generated world.
definitionEn: (of a computer system, film, etc.) making you feel that you are surrounded by and part of the environment, so that you become deeply involved in it.

posExamples.example: Immersive games make players feel as though they were inside the story.
posExamples.translation: 沉浸式游戏让玩家感觉自己就置身于故事之中。

collocations.translation: 沉浸式（虚拟现实）技术（课件）
collocations.example: Immersive technology is changing the way we learn and play.

collocations.translation: 沉浸式虚拟现实游戏（课件）
collocations.example: Immersive games can make learning feel like an adventure.

collocations.translation: 使自己沉浸于……（课件；= be absorbed in）
collocations.example: Since then I've lived alone and immersed myself in my career.

synonyms.example: The lesson was so engaging that time flew by.
synonyms.usage: 作定语/表语；侧重「有吸引力」，immersive 侧重「身临其境、被包围」

advancedExpressions.expression: immerse oneself in sth = be immersed in = be absorbed in（沉浸于）
advancedExpressions.example: She immersed herself in the virtual world for hours.

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ive 形容词后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: immerse (v.) → immersive (adj.)：-ive 表「有……性质的」，同类 create→creative, act→active
advancedExpressions.example: An immersive experience keeps the audience fully involved.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The game makes you feel you are really there.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The immersive game makes players feel as if they were truly present in the scene.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用形容词 immersive 一词概括「身临其境」，句子更凝练。

classPractice.question: Since then I've lived alone and ____ (immerse) myself in my career.
classPractice.note: immerse oneself in sth，此处为过去时态 immersed。

classPractice.question: He was completely absorbed in the virtual world. → He was completely ____ in the virtual world.
classPractice.note: be immersed in = be absorbed in，沉浸于某事物。

classPractice.question: 沉浸式技术让用户感觉身临其境。
classPractice.answer: Immersive technology makes users feel as if they were really there.
classPractice.note: immersive technology 为课件核心搭配；as if 后用虚拟语气 were。

translation: 【课件】吸引（兴趣、注意力）vt.；【课件】使参加，使从事（in）vt.；聘用，雇用 vt.；与……建立密切关系（with）vi.；订婚 vi.
original_sentence: VR can engage students' interest and enhance learning efficiency in the classroom.
definitionEn: to succeed in attracting and keeping somebody's attention and interest; to take part in something; to employ somebody to do a job.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 聘用，雇用（engage sb as sth / to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: He is currently engaged as a consultant.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 与……建立密切关系；深入接触（engage with sb/sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: You want your reader to engage actively with your ideas, not just read them passively.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 订婚（be/get engaged to sb）
uncommonMeanings.example: When did you get engaged to Peter?

posExamples.example: Aside from her exploration, she also engaged us in a discussion.
posExamples.translation: 除了透彻的探索之外，她还让我们参与了一场讨论。

wordForms.meaning: 约定；密切关系；雇用；订婚
有趣的，迷人的，令人愉快的
忙碌的；已订婚的；被占用的

idioms.example: I can't come to dinner on Tuesday — I'm otherwise engaged.

collocations.translation: 吸引某人的兴趣、注意力（课件）
collocations.example: VR can engage students' interest and enhance learning efficiency.
The school urges all students to engage in extracurricular activities.

collocations.translation: 与……建立密切关系，深入接触（课件）
collocations.example: Teachers need to engage with students to enhance learning outcomes.
They were engaged in conversation.
She got engaged to a young man whom she met on the Internet.

synonyms.example: The bright colours attract children's attention.
synonyms.usage: vt.，常接 attention/interest；engage 更强调「持续吸引并留住」

synonyms.example: The project involves students from different grades.
synonyms.usage: vt.，involve sb in sth；与 engage sb in sth 义近，但 engage 更含「主动投入」

advancedExpressions.expression: engage sb's interest（吸引）/ engage sb as sth（聘用）/ engage with sb（密切接触）/ engage in sth（从事）/ be engaged（订婚）
advancedExpressions.example: The company is engaging with its customers to understand their needs.

advancedExpressions.expression: engagement (n. 约定/订婚) / engaging (adj. 迷人的) / engaged (adj. 忙碌的/已订婚)
advancedExpressions.example: She has broken off her engagement to Charles.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: VR makes students interested and helps them learn better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: VR can engage students' interest and enhance learning efficiency.
sentenceUpgrade.note: engage one's interest + enhance efficiency 是课件原句搭配，比 make interested 更书面。

classPractice.question: Her attention ____ (engage) by the display of new hats in the shop window.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用原题】attention 与 engage 之间是被动关系，用一般过去时被动语态 was engaged。

classPractice.question: Just a few days after the signs went up, he found people sitting there and engaging ____ active and joyful conversations.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用原题】engage in sth 表「从事、参加」。

classPractice.question: Our findings show young babies' social ____ (engage) contributes to their own language learning.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用原题】形容词 social 后接名词，用 engagement。

classPractice.question: She got engaged ____ a young man whom she met on the Internet.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用原题】get engaged to sb 表「与某人订婚」。

translation: 双胞胎之一，孪生子 n.；成对的，成双的 adj.；使成对，配对 vt.
original_sentence: A digital twin is a virtual copy of a real object that mirrors its condition in real time.
definitionEn: either of two children born to the same mother at the same time; used to describe two things that are similar or a pair.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 成对的，成双的；孪生的
uncommonMeanings.example: The plane has twin engines mounted under its wings.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使（城市等）结为友好关系；使成对
uncommonMeanings.example: Oxford is twinned with the German town of Bonn.

posExamples.example: The twins look so alike that even their mother sometimes confuses them.
posExamples.translation: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，连他们的母亲有时都分不清。

wordForms.meaning: 使成对，使结为友好城市

collocations.example: Identical twins share the same genes.

collocations.translation: 数字孪生（现实物体的虚拟副本）
collocations.example: Engineers use a digital twin to test the machine before building it.
His twin brother lives in another city.

synonyms.example: Keep a duplicate of the file in case the original is lost.
synonyms.usage: n./adj./vt.；侧重「完全一样的复制品」，twin 侧重「成对、孪生」

advancedExpressions.expression: identical/fraternal twins（同卵/异卵双胞胎）、twin engines（双引擎）、a digital twin（数字孪生）
advancedExpressions.example: A digital twin lets doctors simulate a patient's body.

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·同一词根多词性
advancedExpressions.expression: twin 既作 n.（双胞胎之一）、adj.（成对的）、vt.（使成对），无需变形，靠句法位置区分
advancedExpressions.example: The twin towers were built at the same time.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: There is a virtual copy of the machine on the computer.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The machine has a digital twin that mirrors its real-time condition on the computer.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 digital twin 这一科技术语替换 virtual copy，更贴合科技话题。

classPractice.question: Engineers built a digital ____ of the factory to test new designs safely. (twin / clone)
classPractice.note: digital twin 是「数字孪生」的固定说法，指现实物体的虚拟副本。

classPractice.question: The two sisters are ____ (twin), yet their personalities are completely different.
classPractice.note: 作表语指「两个双胞胎」用复数 twins。

classPractice.question: 这架飞机有两台发动机（成对的）。
classPractice.note: twin 作形容词表「成对的」，twin engines 双引擎。

translation: 【课件】许多，大量（后接可数名词）
original_sentence: There are a host of educational applications of virtual reality.
definitionEn: a large number of people or things.

posExamples.example: The new policy raised a host of questions among the public.
posExamples.translation: 这项新政策在公众中引发了许多问题。

collocations.phrase: a host of applications / problems / reasons
collocations.translation: 许多应用／问题／原因（课件；接可数名词复数）
collocations.example: There are a host of educational applications.
The city offers a whole host of attractions for tourists.

synonyms.example: A large number of students joined the online course.
synonyms.usage: 接可数名词复数，谓语用复数；与 a host of 用法一致

synonyms.example: Numerous studies have proved this point.
synonyms.usage: adj. 作定语，直接接可数名词复数；比 a host of 更正式

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「大量」（接可数）
advancedExpressions.expression: a host of / a large number of / numerous / a multitude of / plenty of + 可数名词复数
advancedExpressions.example: A multitude of factors contribute to climate change.

advancedExpressions.expression: 接可数用 a host of / a number of；接不可数用 a great deal of / an amount of；两者皆可用 plenty of / a lot of
advancedExpressions.example: There is a great deal of interest, and a host of questions, about AI.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: There are many educational uses of VR.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There are a host of educational applications of VR.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 a host of 替换 many，书面语色彩更浓，且强调数量之多。

classPractice.question: VR has a ____ of practical applications, from education to health care. (host / deal)
classPractice.note: a host of 接可数名词 applications；a deal of 接不可数，不符。

classPractice.question: There ____ (be) a host of reasons why people love this game.
classPractice.note: a host of + 可数名词复数作主语，谓语用复数 are。

classPractice.question: A large number of visitors came to the exhibition. → ____ ____ ____ visitors came to the exhibition.
classPractice.note: a host of = a large number of，均接可数名词复数。

translation: 克隆（无性繁殖出的生物），克隆体 n.；克隆，复制 vt.
original_sentence: Scientists warn that cloning humans could raise serious ethical problems.
definitionEn: a plant or an animal that is produced naturally or artificially from the cells of another plant or animal, and is therefore exactly the same as it.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 克隆，无性繁殖；（计算机）复制
uncommonMeanings.example: The team successfully cloned a sheep from a single cell.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （计算机、产品的）复制品，仿制品
uncommonMeanings.example: The cheap phone is basically a clone of the famous brand.

posExamples.example: Dolly the sheep was the first clone of an adult mammal.
posExamples.translation: 多莉羊是第一只成年哺乳动物的克隆体。

collocations.example: Scientists managed to clone a cell from the frog.
Human cloning remains banned in most countries.
The new model is almost an exact clone of last year's design.

synonyms.example: This painting is only a copy of the original.
synonyms.usage: n./vt.；泛指任何复制，clone 特指生物无性繁殖或高度一致的仿制

synonyms.example: She made a duplicate of the key.
synonyms.usage: n./vt.；强调「一模一样的第二份」，clone 更有科技/生物含义

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·clone 词族与搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: clone (n./vt.) / cloning (n.) / human cloning（克隆人）/ clone an organ（克隆器官）
advancedExpressions.example: Cloning organs may one day save many lives.

advancedExpressions.expression: clone 同形兼作 n. 与 vt.，加 -ing 构成 cloning（克隆过程/技术）
advancedExpressions.example: The ethics of cloning are still hotly debated.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Scientists made a copy of the sheep.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Scientists cloned the sheep from a single cell.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用动词 clone 替换 make a copy of，专业且简洁。

classPractice.question: The scientists succeeded in ____ (clone) a sheep from a single cell.
classPractice.note: 介词 in 后接动名词 cloning。

classPractice.question: Dolly the sheep was the world's first ____ of an adult mammal. (clone / copy)
classPractice.note: 生物无性繁殖产生的个体用 clone。

classPractice.question: 许多国家禁止克隆人。
classPractice.note: human cloning 指克隆人技术，作宾语用动名词形式。

translation: 【课件】障碍，阻碍（to）n.；屏障，栅栏，关卡 n.；隔阂，分界线 n.
original_sentence: The high cost remains a barrier to the wider development of virtual reality.
definitionEn: a problem, rule or situation that prevents somebody from doing something, or that makes something impossible; an object like a fence that prevents people from moving forward.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 屏障，栅栏，关卡（实物阻挡物）
uncommonMeanings.example: Police put up barriers to hold back the crowd.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 隔阂，分界线
uncommonMeanings.example: There was no real barrier between reality and fantasy in his mind.

posExamples.example: Lack of confidence is a psychological barrier to success.
posExamples.translation: 缺乏自信是通往成功的一道心理障碍。

collocations.translation: ……的障碍（课件；后接名词或动名词）
collocations.example: The high cost is a barrier to the development of VR.
The language barrier made it hard for them to communicate.

collocations.translation: 消除／打破障碍（课件 remove trade barriers）
collocations.example: The government promised to remove trade barriers.

synonyms.example: Fear of failure is the biggest obstacle to progress.
synonyms.usage: n.，obstacle to sth；与 barrier 义近，barrier 更强调「阻挡通行/发展的界限」

synonyms.example: The fallen tree was an obstruction on the road.
synonyms.usage: n.，多指具体阻挡物或阻挠行为，较正式

advancedExpressions.expression: a barrier to sth（……的障碍）/ language barrier / trade barrier / psychological barrier / break down barriers
advancedExpressions.example: Technology can help break down barriers between cultures.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·barrier to + 动名词
advancedExpressions.expression: barrier 后跟 to 时，to 为介词，后接名词或 doing：a barrier to success / a barrier to communicating
advancedExpressions.example: Shyness can be a barrier to making new friends.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The high cost stops VR from developing widely.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The high cost remains a major barrier to the wider development of VR.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 a barrier to sth 名词结构替换动词从句，句子更精炼有力。

classPractice.question: Lack of confidence is a psychological barrier ____ success.
classPractice.note: barrier to sth，此处 to 为介词。

classPractice.question: The government promised to remove trade ____ between the two countries. (barrier 的正确形式)
classPractice.note: remove trade barriers，可数名词复数。

classPractice.question: 高昂的成本是虚拟现实发展的一大障碍。
classPractice.answer: The high cost is a major barrier to the development of VR.
classPractice.note: a barrier to sth 固定搭配，to 后接名词。

translation: 微调，对……进行细微调整（使达到最佳状态）vt.
original_sentence: Developers keep fine-tuning the system to make the virtual experience more realistic.
definitionEn: to make small changes to something in order to make it work as well as possible.

posExamples.example: The engineers fine-tuned the engine until it ran perfectly.
posExamples.translation: 工程师们对发动机进行了微调，直到它运转得完美无缺。

collocations.example: The team fine-tuned the AI model to improve its accuracy.
We still need to fine-tune a few details before the launch.

synonyms.example: She adjusted the volume slightly.
synonyms.usage: vt.，泛指调整；fine-tune 强调「小幅精细调整以求最佳」

synonyms.example: The engineers refined the design over several months.
synonyms.usage: vt.，强调「逐步完善提高」，与 fine-tune 义近

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·合成词 fine + tune
advancedExpressions.expression: fine（精细的）+ tune（调音/调节）合成 fine-tune（微调），类比 well-known, hand-made
advancedExpressions.example: A well-tuned instrument produces a purer sound; a fine-tuned system runs more smoothly.

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·「调整/完善」动词群
advancedExpressions.expression: fine-tune / adjust / refine / polish / perfect（微调—调整—改进—打磨—完善）
advancedExpressions.example: After weeks of work, they finally perfected the design.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: They keep changing the system a little to make it better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: They keep fine-tuning the system to make it perform at its best.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 fine-tune 一词替换 change a little，更专业地表达「精细微调」。

classPractice.question: The developers are still ____ (fine-tune) the software before it goes on sale.
classPractice.note: be still doing 进行时，用现在分词 fine-tuning。

classPractice.question: Engineers ____ the model to improve its accuracy. (fine-tuned / broke down)
classPractice.note: fine-tune 指微调使其达到最佳，符合语境。

classPractice.question: 开发者不断微调系统，使体验更真实。
classPractice.answer: Developers keep fine-tuning the system to make the experience more realistic.
classPractice.note: keep doing 表反复；fine-tune 作及物动词接宾语 the system。

translation: 【课件】最初的，开始的 adj.；（姓名的）首字母 n.；标上姓名首字母 vt.
original_sentence: The initial cost will discourage most people in the beginning, but that should be fixed over time.
definitionEn: happening at the beginning; existing at the start of a process or situation.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （姓名的）首字母（常用复数 initials）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please sign your initials at the bottom of the form.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 在……上签姓名首字母
uncommonMeanings.example: The manager initialled every page of the contract.

posExamples.example: My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.
posExamples.translation: 我最初的惊讶很快就被喜悦取代了。

wordForms.meaning: 倡议，新方案；主动性；主动权

idioms.meaning: 采取主动，带头（词族 initiative）
idioms.example: It was up to the US to take the initiative in repairing relations.

idioms.meaning: 主动地，自发地（词族 initiative）
idioms.example: You should sort out problems on your own initiative.

collocations.translation: 最初的成本／阶段（课件 in the initial stage of）
collocations.example: The initial cost will discourage most people at first.
His initial reaction was one of shock.

collocations.phrase: in the initial stage of sth
collocations.example: We are still in the initial stage of the campaign.

synonyms.example: This is my first visit to Beijing.
synonyms.usage: adj. 作定语；口语常用，initial 更正式，强调「过程之初的」

synonyms.example: The original plan had to be changed.
synonyms.usage: adj.；侧重「原本的、未经改动的」，initial 侧重「开始阶段的」

advancedExpressions.expression: initial (adj. 最初的) / initially (adv. 起初) / initiate (vt. 发起) / initiative (n. 倡议/主动)
advancedExpressions.example: The trip was initiated by the manager of the community centre.

advancedExpressions.expression: take the initiative（采取主动）/ on one's own initiative（主动地）/ launch an initiative（发起倡议）/ seize the initiative（掌握先机）
advancedExpressions.example: You need to take the initiative and commit a hundred percent.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: At first the cost will put most people off.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The initial cost will discourage most people, but that should be fixed over time.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 the initial cost 名词短语替换 at first the cost，表达更凝练正式。

classPractice.question: 我最初的惊讶很快就被愉悦替代。
classPractice.answer: My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用原题】initial 作定语，表「最初的」。

classPractice.question: 在修复关系方面应由美国采取主动。It was up to the US to ____ ____ ____ in repairing relations.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用原题】take the initiative 采取主动。

classPractice.question: Local ____ (initiate) to help young people have been inadequate.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用原题】此处需名词，指「（帮助年轻人的）措施/倡议」，用复数 initiatives。

translation: 乐观的，抱有希望的（about）adj.
original_sentence: Many scientists remain optimistic about the future of virtual reality despite its current limitations.
definitionEn: expecting good things to happen or something to be successful; showing this feeling.

posExamples.example: She is optimistic that the plan will succeed.
posExamples.translation: 她对这个计划会成功持乐观态度。

collocations.example: Scientists are optimistic about the future of AI.
We are optimistic that the problem will soon be solved.
Despite the setbacks, the team remained optimistic.

synonyms.example: We are hopeful of finding a solution.
synonyms.usage: adj.，be hopeful about/of sth；与 optimistic 义近，语气略轻

synonyms.example: She has a very positive attitude to life.
synonyms.usage: adj.，作定语/表语；侧重「态度积极正面」，optimistic 侧重「对结果抱好预期」

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·optimistic 词族与反义
advancedExpressions.expression: optimistic (adj.) ↔ pessimistic (adj. 悲观的)；optimism (n.) ↔ pessimism (n.)；optimist ↔ pessimist
advancedExpressions.example: An optimist sees opportunity in every difficulty; a pessimist sees difficulty in every opportunity.

advancedExpressions.expression: optim- 词根 + -ist（人）/ -ism（主义）/ -istic（形容词），构成 optimist / optimism / optimistic
advancedExpressions.example: Her natural optimism helped the whole team stay positive.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Many scientists still think VR has a good future.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Many scientists remain optimistic about the future of VR.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 remain optimistic about 替换 still think…good，情感态度更明确、书面。

classPractice.question: The researchers are ____ (optimism) about the future of the project.
classPractice.note: be ... about 之间作表语需用形容词 optimistic。

classPractice.question: Despite all the difficulties, she stayed ____, believing things would get better. (optimistic / pessimistic)
classPractice.note: believing things would get better 表明持乐观态度。

classPractice.question: 科学家们对虚拟现实的未来仍持乐观态度。
classPractice.answer: Scientists remain/are optimistic about the future of virtual reality.
classPractice.note: be optimistic about sth 固定搭配。

translation: 【课件】归结为，基本问题在于（可归纳为……）
original_sentence: In the end, the whole debate about VR boils down to one question: is it worth the cost?
definitionEn: to be able to be explained or summarized as a single main point or reason; to amount essentially to.

posExamples.example: It all boils down to a question of money.
posExamples.translation: 这一切归根结底是个钱的问题。

idioms.meaning: 使人怒不可遏（课件同源短语）
idioms.example: The unfair decision made my blood boil.

collocations.translation: 归结为……，基本问题是……（课件）
collocations.example: In practice, it may boil down to this — what measures the school should take.

collocations.phrase: boil down to the fact that ...
collocations.example: His long letter could boil down to the fact that he felt very sorry for his absence.

synonyms.example: In the end it comes down to personal choice.
synonyms.usage: phrase，come down to sth；与 boil down to 义近，可互换

synonyms.example: His answer amounts to a refusal.
synonyms.usage: phrase，amount to sth；强调「实质上等于」

advancedExpressions.expression: boil down to / come down to / amount to / can be summed up as（归结为、可归纳为）
advancedExpressions.example: The whole issue comes down to trust.

advancedExpressions.expression: boil down to（归结为）/ make one's blood boil（使人愤怒）/ boil with rage（怒不可遏）
advancedExpressions.example: He was boiling with rage when he heard the news.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The whole debate is really about one question.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The whole debate boils down to one question: is it worth the cost?
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 boil down to 替换 is really about，表达「归根结底、去繁存简」更地道。

classPractice.question: In the end, the whole argument ____ ____ ____ a single question of cost. (boils / down / to)
classPractice.note: boil down to sth 归结为；主语单数第三人称,用 boils。

classPractice.question: It all comes down to money in the end. → It all ____ ____ ____ money in the end.
classPractice.note: boil down to = come down to，归结为。

classPractice.question: 关于虚拟现实的整场争论归根结底是一个问题：它值那个价钱吗？
classPractice.answer: The whole debate about virtual reality boils down to one question: is it worth the cost?
classPractice.note: boil down to 后接名词或从句，表「归结为」。

translation: 使恼怒，使生气【课件】；打扰，使烦恼
original_sentence: Does it annoy you to see cars blocking the road like weeds growing in a garden?
definitionEn: to make someone feel slightly angry or impatient; to bother or disturb someone

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 打扰，使烦恼（=bother）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: The mosquitoes annoyed me so much that I couldn't sleep.

posExamples.example: It annoyed me that I didn't have time to do more reading.
posExamples.translation: 我没有时间多读点书，这让我很恼火。

posExamples.example: The constant pop-up ads on the app really annoy users.
posExamples.translation: 这款应用上不停弹出的广告真的让用户很恼火。

wordForms.meaning: 恼怒，生气；使人烦恼的事
恼怒的，生气的（人的感受）
讨厌的，恼人的（事物令人恼火）

collocations.phrase: It annoys sb to do sth
collocations.translation: 做某事使某人恼怒（课件句型）
collocations.example: It annoys me to see people littering in the park.
It annoyed me that I didn't have time to do more reading.

collocations.translation: 使某人极为恼怒的是【课件】
collocations.example: Much to our annoyance, they decided not to come after all.
She stamped her foot in annoyance.

collocations.phrase: be annoyed with sb at / about sth
collocations.translation: 因某事对某人恼火【课件】
collocations.example: He was beginning to get very annoyed with me about my carelessness.

collocations.translation: 做某事时感到恼火【课件】
collocations.example: He was annoyed to find himself going red.

synonyms.example: The noise from the drone irritated the neighbours.
synonyms.usage: vt.，语气与 annoy 相近，常用被动 be irritated by sth；侧重反复刺激引起的烦躁。

synonyms.example: Does the buzzing of the phone bother you?
synonyms.usage: vt.，程度略轻，常用 It bothers sb that / to do sth；也可 don't bother 别费心。

advancedExpressions.expression: annoy v. → annoyance n. → annoyed adj.（人）/ annoying adj.（物）
advancedExpressions.example: The annoying delay was now shorter but still an annoyance, and everyone was annoyed.

advancedExpressions.expression: be annoyed（人被惹恼）vs be annoying（事物令人恼火）
advancedExpressions.example: I was annoyed that they hadn't turned up; it's annoying that they never call ahead.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The ads made me angry.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It really annoyed me that the ads kept popping up while I was reading.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 It annoyed sb that ... 句型，比 made me angry 更地道、书面。

classPractice.question: He was beginning to get very ________ (annoy) with me about my carelessness.
classPractice.note: 描述人的感受用 -ed 形容词 annoyed，后接 with sb about sth。

classPractice.question: It's ________ (annoy) that the chimneys of those plants eject a lot of smoke every day.
classPractice.note: It's ... that ... 中主语指令人恼火的事物，用 -ing 形容词 annoying。

classPractice.question: Much to our ________ (annoy), they decided not to come after all. （用 annoy 的名词形式）
classPractice.note: much to one's annoyance 使某人极为恼怒的是，annoy 的名词为 annoyance。

classPractice.question: 蚊子太扰人了，我根本睡不着。（annoy）
classPractice.answer: The mosquitoes annoyed me so much that I couldn't sleep.
classPractice.note: annoy 表打扰=bother，配 so ... that 结果状语从句。

translation: 杂草，野草（n.）；除去杂草，锄草（v.）
original_sentence: Does it annoy you to see cars blocking the road like weeds growing in a garden?
definitionEn: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted, especially among crops or garden plants

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 除草，锄去（杂草）
uncommonMeanings.example: She spent the morning weeding the vegetable garden.

posExamples.example: The old car park was covered with weeds.
posExamples.translation: 那个旧停车场长满了杂草。

posExamples.example: We must raise the level of research and weed out the poorest work.
posExamples.translation: 我们必须提高研究水平，淘汰最差的成果。

collocations.translation: 淘汰，清除，剔除（不好的人或物）【课件】
collocations.example: We must raise the level of research and weed out the poorest work.
The gardener pulled up the weeds around the roses.
Illegal parking spread like weeds across the city.

advancedExpressions.expression: weed out = get rid of / eliminate 淘汰、清除次品或不合格者
advancedExpressions.example: The screening test is designed to weed out unqualified applicants.

advancedExpressions.expression: weed 参与合成：seaweed 海藻、weedkiller 除草剂
advancedExpressions.example: Farmers spray weedkiller to control the weeds in the fields.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: We should remove the bad research.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We must raise the level of research and weed out the poorest work.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用短语动词 weed out 替换 remove，更形象、地道。

classPractice.question: The company uses interviews to weed ________ candidates who lack experience.
classPractice.note: weed out 淘汰、清除不合格者。

classPractice.question: 花园里的杂草长得很快。（weed）
classPractice.answer: The weeds in the garden grow very fast.
classPractice.note: weed 作可数名词，此处泛指多株杂草用复数 weeds。

classPractice.question: We must raise the level of research and ________ ________ the poorest work. （淘汰）
classPractice.note: 课件原句，weed out 表淘汰、清除。

translation: 最先进的，使用最新技术的，达到最高水准的
original_sentence: The lab is equipped with state-of-the-art technology for developing autonomous vehicles.
definitionEn: using the most modern or advanced techniques or methods; as good as it can be at the present time

posExamples.example: The hospital's state-of-the-art scanners can detect the disease at an early stage.
posExamples.translation: 这家医院最先进的扫描仪能在早期检测出这种疾病。

posExamples.example: Their new smartphone features a state-of-the-art AI chip.
posExamples.translation: 他们的新款智能手机搭载了最先进的人工智能芯片。

collocations.example: The factory runs on state-of-the-art technology.
The research centre boasts state-of-the-art equipment.

collocations.translation: （某领域的）最新技术水平（名词短语，不加连字符）
collocations.example: This robot represents the state of the art in AI research.

synonyms.example: The team uses cutting-edge software to analyse the data.
synonyms.usage: adj.，作前置定语，与 state-of-the-art 几乎等义，均强调技术领先。

synonyms.example: The country has developed advanced satellite technology.
synonyms.usage: adj.，可作表语或定语，语气比 state-of-the-art 平实。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·多词合成形容词
advancedExpressions.expression: state-of-the-art 由 state of the art 加连字符合成，作定语时须带连字符
advancedExpressions.example: They installed state-of-the-art security systems (adj.); this design is truly the state of the art (n.).

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The lab has very modern equipment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The lab is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 state-of-the-art 替换 very modern，词汇更高级、专业。

classPractice.question: 这家公司使用最先进的技术生产电动汽车。（state-of-the-art）
classPractice.answer: The company uses state-of-the-art technology to produce electric cars.
classPractice.note: state-of-the-art 作前置定语修饰 technology，注意连字符。

classPractice.question: The team relies on cutting-edge technology. → The team relies on ________ technology. （用本单元合成词）
classPractice.note: cutting-edge 与 state-of-the-art 同义，均表最先进的。

classPractice.question: This robot represents the state of the ________ in artificial intelligence.
classPractice.note: 名词短语 the state of the art 表某领域最新技术水平，不加连字符。

translation: 地球，世界（the globe）；地球仪；球体
original_sentence: Thanks to satellites, information can now be sent across the globe in seconds.
definitionEn: the world; a ball-shaped model of the earth with a map on it; any object shaped like a ball

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 地球仪
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher pointed to China on the globe.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 球体，球形物
uncommonMeanings.example: A glass globe hung from the ceiling.

posExamples.example: People from all over the globe can now communicate instantly online.
posExamples.translation: 如今全球各地的人都能在网上即时交流。

posExamples.example: Satellites orbit the globe and beam signals to our phones.
posExamples.translation: 卫星绕地球运行，向我们的手机发送信号。

collocations.example: The new app now has users across the globe.
Fans from all over the globe watched the launch online.
She located the North Pole on the globe.

synonyms.example: News now travels around the world in an instant.
synonyms.usage: n.，the globe 常与 the world 互换，around the globe = around the world 更书面。

synonyms.example: We must protect the planet from pollution.
synonyms.usage: n.，指作为天体的地球，环保语境常用 the planet。

advancedExpressions.expression: globe n. → global adj. → globally adv. → globalization n.
advancedExpressions.example: Globalization links the globe, so a local idea can spread globally and become a global trend.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: People everywhere in the world use the Internet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: People across the globe now rely on the Internet.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 across the globe 替换 everywhere in the world，更凝练、书面。

classPractice.question: Thanks to the Internet, ideas can now spread ________ (globe) in seconds.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 spread 用副词 globally。

classPractice.question: The company has offices in over 50 countries across the ________.
classPractice.note: across the globe 遍及全球。

classPractice.question: 卫星使信息几秒内传遍全球。（globe）
classPractice.answer: Satellites allow information to be sent across the globe in seconds.
classPractice.note: across the globe 表遍及全球。

translation: 人造卫星；（天体的）卫星；卫星传送的
original_sentence: Satellites make it possible to broadcast the football match live around the world.
definitionEn: a device sent into space to orbit the earth and pass on signals; a natural body that orbits a planet

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （天体的）卫星，天然卫星
uncommonMeanings.example: The moon is the earth's only natural satellite.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 卫星传送的；附属的（作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: We watched the ceremony on satellite TV.

posExamples.example: The weather satellite sends back images of the clouds every hour.
posExamples.translation: 这颗气象卫星每小时传回一次云层图像。

posExamples.example: China has launched many satellites for navigation and communication.
posExamples.translation: 中国已发射了许多用于导航和通信的卫星。

collocations.example: The country plans to launch a new communications satellite next year.
Drivers rely on satellite navigation to find the way.
The interview was broadcast live via satellite.
Remote villages now receive satellite TV.

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·太空科技词
advancedExpressions.expression: satellite / spacecraft / space station / probe 卫星、航天器、空间站、探测器
advancedExpressions.example: The probe separated from the spacecraft and joined the satellites orbiting the planet.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: We could watch the match live because of technology.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Satellites made it possible to watch the match live around the world.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 以 satellite 作主语用 make it possible to do 结构，信息更聚焦。

classPractice.question: 这个国家去年发射了一颗新的通信卫星。（satellite）
classPractice.answer: The country launched a new communications satellite last year.
classPractice.note: launch a satellite 发射卫星，satellite 为可数名词。

classPractice.question: The whole ceremony was broadcast live ________ satellite.
classPractice.note: via satellite 通过卫星传送。

classPractice.question: The moon is the only natural ________ (satellite) of the earth.
classPractice.note: the only 后接单数名词 satellite。

translation: 花费，费用（sing.）【课件】；（pl.）开支，经费【课件】
original_sentence: Rich regions and individuals benefit at the expense of poorer ones.
definitionEn: the money that you spend on something; the cost of doing something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 花钱的东西；令人破费之事（单数可数）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: Running a car is a big expense.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数）费用，经费，开支【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: The company pays my travel and living expenses.

posExamples.example: The garden was transformed at great expense.
posExamples.translation: 这座花园花了大笔费用才改造好。

posExamples.example: He invited scholars to live and study in Alexandria at his expense.
posExamples.translation: 他出资邀请学者们到亚历山大居住和研究。

wordForms.meaning: 花费，耗费（时间、金钱、精力）

collocations.phrase: at the expense of sb / sth
collocations.translation: 以牺牲……为代价；由某人付款【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: Rich regions benefit at the expense of poorer ones.
The garden was transformed at great expense.

collocations.translation: 自费，由某人自己付款【课件】
collocations.example: He invited scholars to study there at his expense.

collocations.phrase: go to the expense of doing sth
collocations.translation: 不惜花费去做某事【课件】
collocations.example: They went to all the expense of protecting the endangered animals.

collocations.translation: 生活开支／医疗费用【课件】
collocations.example: The payments he gets barely cover his living expenses.
The payments he gets barely cover his expenses.

synonyms.example: The cost of the equipment was very high.
synonyms.usage: n.，指某物的价格或代价；at the cost of 亦可表以……为代价，与 at the expense of 近义。

synonyms.example: Public expenditure on health has risen sharply.
synonyms.usage: n.，较正式，指（政府、机构的）大笔支出，常与 on sth 搭配。

advancedExpressions.expression: at the expense of sth 以牺牲……为代价 / 由……出钱
advancedExpressions.example: He finished the project on time, but at the expense of his health.

advancedExpressions.expression: expense n. → expensive adj. → expend v. → expenditure n.
advancedExpressions.example: The expensive project expended huge funds, and the expenditure came at the expense of other departments.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The rich get richer, but the poor lose out.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The rich benefit at the expense of the poor.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 at the expense of 结构表以牺牲……为代价，凝练地道。

classPractice.question: The payments he gets barely ________ his living ________. （他几乎入不敷出）
classPractice.note: 课件原题，cover one's living expenses 支付生活开支。

classPractice.question: 他按时完成了项目，但以牺牲健康为代价。（at the expense of）
classPractice.answer: He finished the project on time, but at the expense of his health.
classPractice.note: at the expense of sth 以牺牲……为代价。
